title.zh: 卷128 志一百三 河渠三 淮河、永定河、海塘
title.en: Volume 128 Treatises 103: Rivers and Canals 3, Huai He, Yong Ding He, Hai Tang
title.raw: 卷128 志一百三 河渠三 淮河、永定河、海塘

sentences.zh: 志一百三

translations.literal: Treatise 103.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 103.

sentences.zh: 河渠三

translations.literal: Rivers and Canals 3.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers and Canals, Part 3.

sentences.zh: 淮河永定河海塘

translations.literal: Huai River, Yongding River, and Sea Dikes.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai River, the Yongding River, and the Sea Dikes.

sentences.zh: 淮水源出桐柏山，東南經隨州，復北折過桐柏東，歷信陽、確山、羅山、正陽、息、光山、固始、阜陽、霍丘、潁上，所挾支水合而東注，達正陽關。

translations.literal: The Huai River rises on Mount Tongbai, runs southeast through Suizhou, then turns north again east of Tongbai, passing through Xinyang, Queshan, Luoshan, Zhengyang, Xi, Guangshan, Gushi, Fuyang, Huoqiu, and Yingshang; its tributaries join and flow east together to reach Zhengyang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai rises on Mount Tongbai, flows southeast through Suizhou, then bends north again east of Tongbai. It passes Xinyang, Queshan, Luoshan, Zhengyang, Xi, Guangshan, Gushi, Fuyang, Huoqiu, and Yingshang, where its tributaries merge and run east to Zhengyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 其下有沙河、東西淝河、洛河、洱河、芡河、天河，俱入於淮。

translations.literal: Below it are the Sha River, the eastern and western Fei Rivers, the Luo River, the Er River, the Qian River, and the Tian River, all entering the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Downstream tributaries include the Sha, the eastern and western Fei, the Luo, the Er, the Qian, and the Tian Rivers, all of which flow into the Huai.

sentences.zh: 過鳳陽，又有渦河、澥河、東西濠及漴、澮、沱、潼諸水，俱匯淮而注洪澤湖。

translations.literal: Past Fengyang there are also the Wo River, the Xie River, the eastern and western Hao, and the Chong, Hui, Tuo, and Tong streams, all gathering into the Huai and emptying into Hongze Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Fengyang come the Wo and Xie Rivers, the eastern and western Hao, and the Chong, Hui, Tuo, and Tong streams, all of which join the Huai and pour into Hongze Lake.

sentences.zh: 又東北，逕清河、山陽、安東，由雲梯關入海。

translations.literal: Farther northeast it passes Qinghe, Shanyang, and Andong, and enters the sea through Yunti Pass.
translations.idiomatic: It then runs northeast through Qinghe, Shanyang, and Andong, and reaches the sea by way of Yunti Pass.

sentences.zh: 逕行湖北、河南、安徽、江蘇四省，千有七百餘里，淮固不為害也。

translations.literal: Its course runs more than seventeen hundred li through the four provinces of Hubei, Henan, Anhui, and Jiangsu, and the Huai was not in itself a source of harm.
translations.idiomatic: Its course of more than seventeen hundred li crossed Hubei, Henan, Anhui, and Jiangsu, and in itself the Huai was no great menace.

sentences.zh: 自北宋黃河南徙，奪淮瀆下游而入海，於是淮受其病。

translations.literal: From the Northern Song, when the Yellow River shifted south and seized the lower course of the Huai channel to reach the sea, the Huai thereafter suffered the harm.
translations.idiomatic: After the Northern Song, when the Yellow River shifted south and took over the Huai's lower channel to reach the sea, the Huai bore the brunt of the damage.

sentences.zh: 淮病而入淮諸水泛溢四齣，江、安兩省無不病。

translations.literal: When the Huai was afflicted, the waters entering it overflowed in all directions, and the two provinces of Jiangsu and Anhui were alike stricken.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Huai sickened, its tributaries spilled in every direction, and both Jiangsu and Anhui suffered alike.

sentences.zh: 夫下壅則上潰，水性實然，故治河即所以治淮，而治淮莫先於治河。

translations.literal: When the lower course is blocked, the upper course bursts forth—such is the nature of water; therefore to control the river is to control the Huai, and to control the Huai one must first control the river.
translations.idiomatic: Block the lower reach and the upper will break out—that is the nature of water. To manage the Huai one must manage the Yellow River, and managing the Huai begins with managing the river.

sentences.zh: 有清一代，經營於淮、黃交匯之區，致力綦勤，糜帑尤鉅。

translations.literal: Throughout the Qing dynasty, efforts at the junction of the Huai and Yellow Rivers were extraordinarily diligent, and expenditures were especially vast.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Qing, work at the Huai–Yellow River confluence was pursued with extraordinary diligence at enormous cost to the treasury.

sentences.zh: 迨咸豐中，銅瓦廂決，黃流北徙，宋、元來河道為之一變。

translations.literal: By the Xianfeng era, the breach at Tongwaxiang caused the Yellow River to shift north, and the channel pattern since Song and Yuan times was transformed.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianfeng period the breach at Tongwaxiang sent the Yellow River north again, transforming the channel pattern that had held since Song and Yuan times.

sentences.zh: 然河徙淤留，導淮之舉又烏容已。

translations.literal: Yet with the river's shift came silt and blockage, and the work of guiding the Huai could not be set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the river's shift left silt behind, and efforts to guide the Huai could not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 今於淮流之源委分合，及清口之蓄泄，洪澤湖之堰壩工築，皆備列焉。

translations.literal: Here the Huai's sources, course, divisions, and unions, the storage and release at Qingkou, and the dikes and dams built on Hongze Lake are all set forth in full.
translations.idiomatic: What follows records in full the Huai's sources and branches, the storage and release at Qingkou, and the dikes and dams built on Hongze Lake.

sentences.zh: 順治六年夏，淮溢息縣，壞民田舍。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year of Shunzhi, the Huai overflowed at Xi County and destroyed people's fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Shunzhi 6, the Huai flooded Xi County and destroyed farmland and homes.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，盱、泗民由古溝鎮南及谷家橋北盜決小渠八，淮水強半分泄高、寶諸湖，而清口淮弱，無力敵黃。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, people of Xuyi and Sizhou illicitly cut eight small channels south of Gugou Town and north of Gujia Bridge; more than half the Huai's water was diverted into the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes, while at Qingkou the Huai was weak and unable to withstand the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1, residents of Xuyi and Sizhou illegally cut eight small channels south of Gugou Town and north of Gujia Bridge, diverting more than half the Huai into the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes. At Qingkou the Huai ran too weak to hold back the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 六七年間，淮大漲，沖潰古溝、翟家墩，由高、寶諸湖直射運河，決清水潭，又溢武家墩、高良澗，清口湮而黃流上潰。

translations.literal: In the sixth and seventh years the Huai rose greatly, burst Gugou and Zhaijiadun, shot straight from the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes into the Grand Canal, broke through Qingshui Tan, and also overflowed Wujiadun and Gaoliangjian; Qingkou silted up and the Yellow River surged upward.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6–7 the Huai swelled, broke through Gugou and Zhaijiadun, and poured from the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes straight into the Grand Canal. It breached Qingshui Tan and flooded Wujiadun and Gaoliangjian; Qingkou silted shut while the Yellow River backed up.

sentences.zh: 十五年，淮又大漲，合睢湖諸水並力東激，高良澗板工決口二十六，高堰石工決口七，涓滴不出清口。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Huai rose again; joining the waters of Sui Lake and others, it drove east with combined force. Twenty-six breaches opened in the plank works at Gaoliangjian and seven in the stone works at Gaoyan; not a drop issued from Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 15 the Huai rose again, joined by Sui Lake and other waters driving east together. Twenty-six breaches opened in the plank revetments at Gaoliangjian and seven in the stone works at Gaoyan, and not a drop passed Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 黃又乘高四潰，一入洪澤湖，由高堰決口會淮，並歸清水潭，下流益淤墊。

translations.literal: The Yellow River, riding high, burst in four directions; one stream entered Hongze Lake, joined the Huai through the breaches at Gaoyan, and all flowed to Qingshui Tan, while the lower course silted ever more heavily.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River, riding high, broke out in four directions. One stream entered Hongze Lake, met the Huai through the Gaoyan breaches, and all poured toward Qingshui Tan as the lower course silted ever deeper.

sentences.zh: 總河靳輔言：「洪澤下流，自高堰西至清口約二十里，原系汪洋巨浸，為全淮會黃之所。

translations.literal: Director-General Jin Fu said: "The lower reach of Hongze, from Gaoyan west to Qingkou, about twenty li, was originally a vast expanse where the whole Huai met the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Director-General Jin Fu reported: "The lower reach of Hongze, from Gaoyan west to Qingkou—about twenty li—was once a vast sheet of water where the entire Huai met the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 自淮東決、黃內灌，一帶湖身漸成平陸，止存寬十餘丈、深五六尺至一二尺之小河，淤沙萬頃，挑濬甚難。

translations.literal: Since the Huai broke east and the Yellow River poured in, that stretch of lake has gradually become level land, leaving only a small river ten-odd zhang wide and five or six chi deep, or one or two chi, with tens of thousands of mu of silt; dredging is extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: After the Huai broke east and the Yellow River flooded in, that stretch of lakebed has silted into level ground, leaving only a channel ten-odd zhang wide and five or six chi deep—or as little as one or two. Tens of thousands of mu of silt make dredging extremely difficult.

sentences.zh: 惟有於兩旁離水二十丈許，各挑引河一，俾分頭沖刷，庶淮河下注，可以沖辟淤泥，徑奔清口，會黃刷沙，而無阻滯散漫之虞。」

translations.literal: One must dig a diversion channel on each side about twenty zhang from the water, so that they may scour separately; then the Huai flowing down can cut through the silt, run straight to Qingkou, meet the Yellow River and scour sand, without fear of blockage or dispersion."
translations.idiomatic: The only remedy is to dig a diversion channel on each bank about twenty zhang from the waterline so they can scour separately. Then the Huai descending can cut through the silt, run straight to Qingkou, meet the Yellow River and scour away sand, without risk of blockage or spreading."

sentences.zh: 輔又言：「下流既治，淮可直行會黃刷沙，但臨湖一帶堤岸，除決口外，無不殘缺單薄，危險堪虞。

translations.literal: Fu further said: "Once the lower course is repaired, the Huai can run straight to meet the Yellow River and scour sand, but the lakeside dikes, apart from breach sites, are all broken and thin, perilously unsafe.
translations.idiomatic: Fu added: "Once the lower course is repaired, the Huai can run straight to meet the Yellow River and scour sand. But along the lakeshore, apart from the breach sites, every dike is broken and thin—dangerously unsafe.

sentences.zh: 板工固易壞，即石工之傾圮亦不可勝數。

translations.literal: Plank works are indeed easily destroyed, and even the collapsed stone works are beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Plank revetments fail easily, and even the stone works that have collapsed are beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 惟堤下系土坦坡，雖遇大水不易沖，今求費省工堅，惟有於堤外近湖處挑土幫築坦坡。

translations.literal: Only earthen slopes below the dike, though meeting great floods, are not easily washed away; seeking economy and solidity, one should dig earth on the lakeside outside the dike and build supporting slopes.
translations.idiomatic: Earthen slopes below the dike resist even major floods. To save cost and build solidly, earth should be taken from the lakeside face of the dike and built into supporting slopes.

sentences.zh: 每堤一丈，築坦坡寬五尺，密布草根草子其上，俟其長茂，則土益堅。

translations.literal: For each zhang of dike, build a slope five chi wide, densely sow grass roots and seed on it, and when they grow thick the earth will grow firmer.
translations.idiomatic: For each zhang of dike, build a five-chi-wide slope and densely sow grass roots and seed on it; once they grow thick, the earth will bind firmer still.

sentences.zh: 至高堰石工，亦宜幫築坦坡，埋石工於內，更為堅穩，較之用板用石用埽，可省二十一萬有奇，且免衝激頹卸之患。」

translations.literal: At the stone works of Gaoyan, slopes should also be built up, burying the stone works within for greater stability; compared with using planks, stone, and fascines, more than 210,000 taels can be saved, and the hazard of impact and collapse avoided."
translations.idiomatic: At Gaoyan's stone works, supporting slopes should be built as well, with the stonework buried inside for greater stability. Compared with planks, stone, and fascines, this saves more than 210,000 taels and avoids the hazard of impact and collapse."

sentences.zh: 又言：「自周家閘歷古溝、唐埂至翟家壩南，估計築三十二里之堤，並堵此原沖成之九河，及高良澗、高家堰、武家墩大小決口三十四，需費七十萬五千有奇，皆系用埽，不過三年，悉皆朽壞。

translations.literal: He also said: "From Zhoujia Sluice through Gugou and Tang'eng to south of Zhaijiaba, it is estimated that building thirty-two li of dike, blocking the nine rivers originally cut by floods, and the thirty-four large and small breaches at Gaoliangjian, Gaojiayan, and Wujiadun will require more than 705,000 taels, all using fascines that within three years will all rot away.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "From Zhoujia Sluice through Gugou and Tang'eng to south of Zhaijiaba, building thirty-two li of dike, blocking the nine channels cut by earlier floods, and repairing the thirty-four breaches large and small at Gaoliangjian, Gaojiayan, and Wujiadun is estimated at more than 705,000 taels—all in fascines that rot within three years.

sentences.zh: 臣斟酌變通，除鑲邊裹頭必須用埽，餘俱宜密下排椿，多加板纜，用蒲包裹土，繩扎而填之，費可省半，而堅久過之。

translations.literal: Your servant has weighed alternatives: except where fascines are required for edging and capping, elsewhere one should set rows of piles closely, add many plank cables, wrap earth in rushes, bind with rope and fill in; cost can be halved and durability will exceed the old method.
translations.idiomatic: I have weighed alternatives: fascines are needed only for edging and capping. Elsewhere rows of piles should be set closely, with extra plank cables, earth wrapped in rushes and bound with rope—halving the cost while lasting longer.

sentences.zh: 今擬改下埽為包土，仍築坦坡。」

translations.literal: It is now proposed to replace fascines with wrapped earth and still build slopes."
translations.idiomatic: The plan is to replace fascines with wrapped earth and still build supporting slopes."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，大濬清口、爛泥淺、裴家場、帥家莊引河，使淮水全出清口，會黃東下。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Qingkou, Lanniqian, Peijiachang, and Shuaizhuang diversion channels were greatly dredged so that all Huai water issued from Qingkou and met the Yellow River flowing east.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 18, Qingkou and the diversion channels at Lanniqian, Peijiachang, and Shuaizhuang were heavily dredged so the full Huai discharge reached Qingkou and joined the Yellow River flowing east.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，總河董安國因泗州知州莫之翰議，請開盱眙聖人山禹王河，導淮注江，略言：「禹王古河，自盱眙聖人山歷黑林橋、桐城鎮、楊村、天長縣迄六合之八里橋，各有河形溪澗崗不等。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, Director-General Dong Anguo, following the proposal of Sizhou prefect Mo Zhihan, requested opening the Yuwang River at Shengren Mountain in Xuyi to guide the Huai into the Yangtze, stating in summary: "The ancient Yuwang River from Shengren Mountain in Xuyi through Heilin Bridge, Tongcheng Town, Yangcun, Tianchang County to Bali Bridge in Liuhe shows river traces, streams, ravines, and ridges in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35, Director-General Dong Anguo, following Sizhou Prefect Mo Zhihan's proposal, asked to open the Yuwang River at Shengren Mountain in Xuyi to divert the Huai toward the Yangtze. He summarized: "The ancient Yuwang channel from Shengren Mountain in Xuyi through Heilin Bridge, Tongcheng, Yangcun, and Tianchang to Bali Bridge in Liuhe still shows traces—streams, ravines, and ridges in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 若開引入江，則天長、楊村、桐城各汊澗，大水時可不入高郵湖，湖水不致泛溢，而下河之水可減。

translations.literal: If opened to the river, the branches and streams at Tianchang, Yangcun, and Tongcheng in times of great flood need not enter Gaoyou Lake; lake water would not spread overflow, and the waters of the lower river could be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: If opened to the Yangtze, the branches at Tianchang, Yangcun, and Tongcheng could carry floodwater without pouring into Gaoyou Lake, easing overflow and reducing pressure on the lower river.

sentences.zh: 至古河之口，現與淮不通流，必立閘座，水小閉閘以濟漕，漲則開閘以泄水，庶淮水洶湧之勢可減。」

translations.literal: At the mouth of the ancient river, which now does not connect with the Huai, sluice gates must be built; when water is low, close the gates to aid the grain transport, and when it rises, open them to release water, so that the surging force of the Huai may be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: At the ancient mouth, which no longer connects to the Huai, sluice gates must be built: closed when water is low to aid the grain transport, opened when it rises to discharge flood, easing the Huai's surging force."

sentences.zh: 格廷議不行。

translations.literal: Court discussion blocked it and it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Court deliberation rejected the plan.

sentences.zh: 明年，上有宜堵塞高堰壩之諭。

translations.literal: The next year, the throne issued an edict that the Gaoyan dams should be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the throne ordered that the Gaoyan dams be sealed.

sentences.zh: 逾二年，總河于成龍申塞六壩之請。

translations.literal: After two years, Director-General Yu Chenglong submitted a request to block the six dams.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Director-General Yu Chenglong petitioned to seal the six dams.

sentences.zh: 會病卒，未底厥績。

translations.literal: He fell ill and died before the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: He fell ill and died before the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 其年水復大至，已堵三壩，旋委洪流。

translations.literal: That year floodwaters came again; three dams had been blocked, but they soon yielded to the torrent.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods returned; three dams had been sealed, but they soon gave way to the torrent.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，張鵬翮為總河，盡塞之，使淮無所漏，悉歸清口；

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year Zhang Penghe became Director-General, blocked them all so the Huai had no outlet, and all returned to Qingkou;
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 39 Zhang Penghe became Director-General, sealed them all so the Huai had no escape, and sent the full discharge to Qingkou;

sentences.zh: 又開張福、裴家場、張家莊、爛泥淺、三岔及天然、天賜引河七，導淮以刷清口；

translations.literal: he also opened seven diversion channels—Zhangfu, Peijiachang, Zhangjiazhuang, Lanniqian, Sancha, and the Natural and Heavenly Gift channels—to guide the Huai and scour Qingkou;
translations.idiomatic: he also opened seven diversion channels—Zhangfu, Peijiachang, Zhangjiazhuang, Lanniqian, Sancha, and the Natural and Heavenly Gift channels—to guide the Huai and scour Qingkou;

sentences.zh: 又以清口引河寬僅三十餘丈，不足暢泄全湖之水，加開寬闊。

translations.literal: and because the Qingkou diversion was only thirty-odd zhang wide, insufficient to release all the lake water freely, he widened it further.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Qingkou diversion was only thirty-odd zhang wide—too narrow to release the full lake discharge—he widened it further.

sentences.zh: 於是十餘年斷絕之清流，一旦奮涌而出，淮高於黃者尺餘。

translations.literal: Thus clear water cut off for more than ten years burst forth at once, and the Huai stood more than a chi higher than the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Clear water cut off for more than ten years burst forth at once, and the Huai stood more than a chi above the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 四十年，築高堰大堤。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year the great dike at Gaoyan was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 40 the great Gaoyan dike was built.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，聖祖南巡，閱高堰堤工，詔於三壩下濬河築堤，束水入高郵、邵伯諸湖。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year the Sage Ancestor toured south, inspected the Gaoyan dike works, and ordered dredging and dike-building below the three dams to confine water into the Gaoyou, Shaobo, and other lakes.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 44 the Kangxi Emperor toured south, inspected the Gaoyan works, and ordered dredging and dikes below the three dams to confine water in Gaoyou, Shaobo, and the other lakes.

sentences.zh: 又洪湖水漲，泗、盱均被水災，應於受水處酌量築堤束水。

translations.literal: Hongze Lake also rose; Sizhou and Xuyi were both stricken by flood, and dikes should be built proportionately where water was received to confine it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongze Lake also rose, flooding Sizhou and Xuyi; dikes should be built proportionately at the points receiving water to confine it.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，兩江總督阿山等請於泗州溜淮套別開河道，直達張福口，以分淮勢，計費三百十餘萬。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year Liangjiang Governor-General Ashan and others requested opening a separate channel at Liuhuaitao in Sizhou straight to Zhangfukou to divide the Huai's force, estimated at more than 3.1 million taels.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 45 Liangjiang Governor-General Ashan and others proposed cutting a new channel at Liuhuaitao in Sizhou straight to Zhangfukou to split the Huai's force, at an estimated cost of more than 3.1 million taels.

sentences.zh: 部議靳之。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberation rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry rejected the plan.

sentences.zh: 廷臣亦以河工重大，請上親臨指示。

translations.literal: Court officials also, considering the river works momentous, asked the emperor to inspect in person and give direction.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials, deeming the project too momentous, asked the emperor to inspect in person.

sentences.zh: 逾年，上南巡閱河，諭曰：「詳勘溜淮套地勢甚高，雖開鑿成河，亦不能直達清口。

translations.literal: The next year the emperor toured south to inspect the river and instructed: "Detailed survey shows Liuhuaitao's terrain is very high; even if a channel were cut, it could not reach Qingkou directly.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor toured south to inspect the river and said: "Survey shows Liuhuaitao lies very high; even if a channel were cut, it could not reach Qingkou directly.

sentences.zh: 且所立標杆多在墳上，若依此開河，不獨壞田廬，甚至毀墳冢，何必多此一事。

translations.literal: Moreover the survey stakes stand mostly on graves; if a river were opened accordingly, not only fields and houses would be ruined, but even tombs destroyed—why add this needless affair.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the survey stakes stand mostly on graves. Opening a channel on this line would ruin fields and homes—and destroy tombs as well. Why add this needless work?

sentences.zh: 今欲開溜淮套，必鑿山穿嶺，不獨斷難成功，且恐汛水泛溢，不浸入洪湖，必衝決運河。」

translations.literal: To open Liuhuaitao now would require cutting through mountains and ridges; success would surely be impossible, and I fear flood season overflow would not enter Hongze Lake but must burst the Grand Canal."
translations.idiomatic: Opening Liuhuaitao would require cutting through mountains and ridges—surely impossible—and flood-season overflow would bypass Hongze Lake and burst the Grand Canal instead."

sentences.zh: 命撤去標杆，並譴阿山、鵬翮等有差。

translations.literal: He ordered the stakes removed and punished Ashan, Penghe, and others to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the stakes removed and punished Ashan, Penghe, and others accordingly.

sentences.zh: 上又謂：「明代淮、黃與今迥異。

translations.literal: The emperor also said: "In the Ming the Huai and Yellow rivers differed utterly from today.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also said: "In Ming times the Huai and Yellow rivers bore no resemblance to today.

sentences.zh: 明代淮弱，故有倒灌之虞。

translations.literal: In the Ming the Huai was weak, hence the fear of backflow.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming the Huai was weak, hence the fear of it backing up.

sentences.zh: 今則淮強黃弱。

translations.literal: Now the Huai is strong and the Yellow River weak.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Huai is strong and the Yellow River weak.

sentences.zh: 與其開溜淮套無益之河，不若於洪湖出水處再行挑濬寬深，使清水愈加暢流，為利不淺。」

translations.literal: Rather than opening the useless Liuhuaitao channel, it is better to dredge wider and deeper at Hongze Lake's outflow so clear water flows more freely—the benefit would be no small matter."
translations.idiomatic: Rather than opening the useless Liuhuaitao channel, dredge Hongze Lake's outflow wider and deeper so clear water runs more freely—the benefit would be considerable."

sentences.zh: 四十九年，加長御黃西壩工程，從河督趙世顯請也。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year the western Yellow River-control dam works were extended, following River Director Zhao Shixian's request.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 49 the western Yellow River-control dam was extended, at River Director Zhao Shixian's request.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，重建清口東西束水壩於風神廟前以蓄清，各長二十餘丈。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng the eastern and western clear-water retention dams at Qingkou were rebuilt before the Fengshen Temple to store clear water, each more than twenty zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 the eastern and western clear-water retention dams at Qingkou were rebuilt before the Fengshen Temple to store clear water, each more than twenty zhang long.

sentences.zh: 三年，總河齊蘇勒因硃家海衝決，湖底沙淤，恐高堰難保，改低三壩門檻一尺五寸以洩湖水，而救一時之急。

translations.literal: In the third year Director-General Qi Sule, because Zhujiahai burst and the lake bottom silted, fearing Gaoyan could not be held, lowered the three dams' sills by one chi five cun to release lake water and meet the urgent moment.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 Director-General Qi Sule, after Zhujiahai burst and the lakebed silted, fearing Gaoyan could not hold, lowered the three dams' sills by one chi five cun to release lake water—a stopgap measure.

sentences.zh: 不知水愈落，淮愈不得出，致力微不能敵黃，連年倒灌，分溜直趨。

translations.literal: He did not know that as water fell lower, the Huai could issue even less; its force was slight and could not withstand the Yellow River; year after year there was backflow, and divided currents rushed straight on.
translations.idiomatic: He did not realize that as the water level dropped, the Huai could discharge even less—too weak to hold back the Yellow River. Year after year the river backed up and split currents rushed onward.

sentences.zh: 李衛頗非之。

translations.literal: Li Wei strongly disapproved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei strongly disapproved.

sentences.zh: 先是高堰石工未能一律堅厚。

translations.literal: Previously the stone works at Gaoyan had not been uniformly solid and thick.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Gaoyan stonework had not been uniformly solid.

sentences.zh: 至七年冬，發帑百萬，命總河孔繼珣、總督尹繼善將堤身卑薄傾圮處拆砌，務令一律堅實。

translations.literal: By the winter of the seventh year a million taels were issued, and Director-General Kong Jixun and Governor-General Yin Jishan were ordered to dismantle and rebuild low, thin, and collapsed sections of the dike body so that all would be uniformly solid.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Yongzheng 7 a million taels were issued, and Director-General Kong Jixun and Governor-General Yin Jishan were ordered to rebuild every low, thin, or collapsed section until the dike was uniformly solid.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，高堰石工成。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year the Gaoyan stone works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Yongzheng 10 the Gaoyan stonework was completed.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，用總河高斌言，飭疏濬毛城鋪迤下河道，經徐、蕭、睢、宿、靈、虹各州縣，至泗州之安門陡河，紆曲六百餘里，以達洪湖，出清口，而淮揚京員夏之芳等言其不便。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, following Director-General Gao Bin's proposal, orders were issued to dredge the channel from Maochengpu downstream through the prefectures and counties of Xu, Xiao, Sui, Su, Ling, and Hong to Anmen Douhe in Sizhou—a winding course of more than six hundred li to reach Hongze Lake and issue at Qingkou—while Huai-Yang capital officials Xia Zhifang and others said it was impracticable.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2, following Director-General Gao Bin's proposal, orders went out to dredge the channel from Maochengpu downstream through Xu, Xiao, Sui, Su, Ling, and Hong to Anmen Douhe in Sizhou—a winding six-hundred-li course to Hongze Lake and Qingkou—while Huai-Yang capital officials Xia Zhifang and others objected that it was impracticable.

sentences.zh: 下各督撫及河、漕督會議，並召詢斌。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down for conference among governors-general and governors and the river and grain transport directors, and Bin was summoned for inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the governors-general, governors, and river and grain transport directors for conference, and Bin was summoned for questioning.

sentences.zh: 斌至，進圖陳說，乃知芳等所言非現在情形，卒從斌議。

translations.literal: When Bin arrived he presented maps and explained, and it was learned that what Fang and others said did not match present conditions; in the end Bin's proposal was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Bin arrived, presented maps and explained, and it became clear that Fang and others were describing conditions that no longer held. In the end Bin's plan was adopted.

sentences.zh: 明年，毛城鋪河道工竣。

translations.literal: The next year the Maochengpu channel works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Maochengpu channel works were completed.

sentences.zh: 四年，高宗以高堰三壩既改低，過岸之水足泄，用大學士鄂爾泰言，永禁開放天然二壩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Gaozong Emperor, since the three Gaoyan dams had been lowered and water overtopping the banks could be fully released, following Grand Secretary Ortai's advice permanently forbade opening the two Natural dams.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 4 the Qianlong Emperor, since the three Gaoyan dams had been lowered and overtopping water could be fully discharged, following Grand Secretary Ortai permanently forbade opening the two Natural dams.

sentences.zh: 五年秋，西風大暴，湖浪洶湧，高堰汛第八堡舊堤撞擊，倒卸十四段，旋修補之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fifth year a violent west wind raised surging lake waves; the old dike at the eighth bastion of the Gaoyan flood section was struck and fourteen sections collapsed, and were soon repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Qianlong 5 a violent west wind raised surging lake waves; the old dike at the eighth bastion of the Gaoyan flood section was struck and fourteen sections collapsed, and were soon repaired.

sentences.zh: 六年，斌言：「江都三汊河乃瓜、儀二河口門，瓜河地勢低，淮水入瓜河分數少，故溜緩不能刷深，河道致日漸淤墊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Bin said: "The San Cha River at Jiangdu is the mouth of the Guazhou and Yizhen rivers; Guazhou's terrain is low, and little Huai water enters it, so the current is slow and cannot scour deep, and the channel daily silts more heavily.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 6 Bin reported: "The San Cha River at Jiangdu is the mouth of the Guazhou and Yizhen channels. Guazhou lies low, so little Huai water enters it; the current is too slow to scour deep, and the channel silts daily.

sentences.zh: 應築壩堵閉瓜河舊口門，于洋子橋營房迤下別挑越河，減淮水入瓜河之分數，則儀河可分流刷淤，並堵閉瓜洲廣惠閘之舊越河，於閘下別開越河，使閘越二河水勢均平，既緩淮水直下入江之勢，於運道更為便利。」

translations.literal: A dam should be built to block the old Guazhou mouth; below Yangzi Bridge camp a separate overflow channel should be cut to reduce the share of Huai water entering Guazhou, so Yizhen River can divide flow and scour silt; also block the old overflow at Guazhou's Guanghui Sluice and open a new overflow below the sluice so sluice and overflow currents are balanced, easing the Huai's direct rush into the river and benefiting the transport route more."
translations.idiomatic: A dam should block the old Guazhou mouth; below Yangzi Bridge camp a new overflow channel should be cut to reduce Huai water entering Guazhou so Yizhen can divide flow and scour silt. The old overflow at Guazhou's Guanghui Sluice should be blocked and a new one opened below the sluice to balance the currents, easing the Huai's direct rush into the Yangtze and aiding the transport route."

sentences.zh: 七年，河湖並漲，議者又謂淮河上游諸水俱匯入洪湖，邵伯以下宜多開入江之路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year river and lake rose together; advocates again said all upstream Huai waters gathered in Hongze Lake, and below Shaobo more routes into the river should be opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 7 river and lake rose together; advocates again argued that all upstream Huai waters gathered in Hongze Lake and that below Shaobo more outlets to the Yangtze should be opened.

sentences.zh: 斌亦以為言。

translations.literal: Bin also spoke to this effect.
translations.idiomatic: Bin agreed.

sentences.zh: 於是開濬石羊溝舊河直達於江，築滾壩四十丈，並開通芒稻閘下之董家油房、白塔河之孔家涵三處河流，增建滾壩，使淮水暢流無阻。

translations.literal: Thereupon the old Shiyang Gou channel was dredged straight to the river, a forty-zhang rolling dam was built, and the three streams at Dongjiayoufang below Mangdao Sluice and Kongjiahan on Baita River were opened, with added rolling dams, so Huai water flowed freely without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The old Shiyang Gou channel was dredged straight to the Yangtze and a forty-zhang rolling dam built. The streams at Dongjiayoufang below Mangdao Sluice and Kongjiahan on Baita River were opened and rolling dams added so Huai water could flow freely.

sentences.zh: 八年，淮暴漲丈餘，逼臨淮城，改治於周樑橋。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Huai rose violently more than a zhang, pressing upon Linhuai city; administration was moved to Zhouliang Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 8 the Huai rose more than a zhang in a sudden flood, threatening Linhuai city; the seat of government was moved to Zhouliang Bridge.

sentences.zh: 十六年，上以天然壩乃高堰尾閭，盛漲輒開，下游州縣悉被其患，命立石永禁開放。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the emperor, since the Natural Dam was the tail of Gaoyan and was opened whenever floods were high, afflicting all downstream prefectures and counties, ordered a stone set up permanently forbidding its opening.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 16 the emperor, noting that the Natural Dam at the tail of Gaoyan was opened in every major flood and devastated downstream counties, ordered a stone inscription permanently forbidding its opening.

sentences.zh: 並用斌言，於三壩外增建智、信二壩，以資宣洩。

translations.literal: Following Bin's advice, the Zhi and Xin dams were added outside the three dams to aid discharge.
translations.idiomatic: Following Bin's advice, the Zhi and Xin dams were added beyond the three dams to aid discharge.

sentences.zh: 十八年七月，淮溢高郵，壞車邏壩、邵伯二閘，下河田廬多沒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighteenth year the Huai overflowed at Gaoyou, destroying the Cheluo Dam and the two Shaobo sluices; many fields and dwellings of the lower river were submerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Qianlong 18 the Huai flooded Gaoyou, destroying the Cheluo Dam and the two Shaobo sluices; many fields and homes in the lower river were submerged.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以湖水出清口，賴東西二壩堵束，並力刷黃，湖水過大，奔溢五壩，亦恐為下河患。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, since lake water issued at Qingkou relying on the eastern and western dams to confine it and scour the Yellow River together, when lake water was excessive it rushed over the five dams, also feared as a calamity for the lower river.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22, since lake water issued at Qingkou only because the eastern and western dams confined it to scour the Yellow River together, excessive lake water spilled over the five dams—a feared calamity for the lower river.

sentences.zh: 因定制五壩過水一寸，東壩開寬二丈，以此遞增，泐石東壩。

translations.literal: Therefore a rule was fixed: one cun of water over the five dams, the eastern dam opened two zhang wide, increasing by this ratio, and the eastern dam was inscribed in stone.
translations.idiomatic: A rule was fixed: one cun over the five dams, the eastern dam opened two zhang wide, increasing by that ratio, and the rule was carved on the eastern dam.

sentences.zh: 嗣是遇湖水增長，即展寬東壩以洩盛漲，有展寬至六七十丈者。

translations.literal: Thereafter whenever lake water rose, the eastern dam was widened to release great floods, sometimes widened to sixty or seventy zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter whenever lake water rose, the eastern dam was widened to release major floods—sometimes to sixty or seventy zhang.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，上言：「江南濱湖之區，每遇大汛，霖潦堪虞，洪澤一湖，尤為橐籥關鍵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the emperor said: "In Jiangnan's lake-border regions, every great flood season brings fear of prolonged rain and inundation; Hongze Lake above all is the key bellows.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 the emperor said: "In Jiangnan's lake-border regions, every major flood season brings prolonged rain and inundation; Hongze Lake above all is the critical valve.

sentences.zh: 為澤國計安全，莫如廣疏清口，為及今第一要義。

translations.literal: To secure this water country, nothing surpasses broadly dredging Qingkou—this is the first essential at present.
translations.idiomatic: To secure this water country, nothing matters more than broadly dredging Qingkou—that is the first priority now.

sentences.zh: 現在高堰五壩高於水面七尺有奇，清口口門見寬三十丈，當即依此酌定成算。

translations.literal: At present the five Gaoyan dams stand more than seven chi above water; the Qingkou mouth is now thirty zhang wide—calculations should be fixed accordingly at once.
translations.idiomatic: At present the five Gaoyan dams stand more than seven chi above water and the Qingkou mouth is thirty zhang wide—plans should be fixed accordingly at once.

sentences.zh: 將來兩壩水增長至一尺，拆寬清口十丈，水遞長，口遞寬，以此為率。」

translations.literal: When in future water at the two dams rises to one chi, widen Qingkou ten zhang; as water rises step by step, widen the mouth step by step—let this be the rule."
translations.idiomatic: When water at the two dams rises one chi, widen Qingkou ten zhang; as water rises, widen the mouth proportionally—that shall be the rule."

sentences.zh: 是年六月，五壩水志逾一尺。

translations.literal: That year in the sixth month the flood mark at the five dams exceeded one chi.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the sixth month the flood mark at the five dams exceeded one chi.

sentences.zh: 河督高晉遵旨拆寬清口十丈，宣洩甚暢。

translations.literal: River Director Gao Jin followed the edict and widened Qingkou ten zhang; discharge was very free.
translations.idiomatic: River Director Gao Jin followed the edict and widened Qingkou ten zhang; discharge ran very freely.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，南河總督李宏言：「正陽關三官廟舊立水志，考驗水痕，本年所報消長，與下游不符。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Southern Rivers Governor-General Li Hong said: "The old flood mark at Sanguan Temple at Zhengyang Pass, when water traces are checked, shows rise and fall reported this year inconsistent with downstream.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 32 Southern Rivers Governor-General Li Hong reported: "The old flood mark at Sanguan Temple at Zhengyang Pass no longer matches downstream conditions—the rise and fall reported this year do not agree.

sentences.zh: 請於荊山、塗山間及臨淮鎮，各增設水志一，以驗諸水消長。」

translations.literal: Please add one flood mark each between Jing Mountain and Tu Mountain and at Linhuai Town, to verify the rise and fall of all waters."
translations.idiomatic: Please add flood marks between Jing Mountain and Tu Mountain and at Linhuai Town to verify water levels throughout the system."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，上恐高堰五壩頂封土障水，不足當風浪，命酌加石工。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year the emperor feared the earthen caps on the five Gaoyan dams blocking water were insufficient against wind and waves, and ordered stone works added as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 34 the emperor feared the earthen caps on the five Gaoyan dams could not withstand wind and waves, and ordered stone reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 高晉等言其不便，乃增用柴柳。

translations.literal: Gao Jin and others said it was impracticable, and brush and willow were added instead.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin and others said stone was impracticable, and brush and willow were added instead.

sentences.zh: 四十年，大修堰、盱各壩及臨河磚石工。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year major repairs were made to the dams at Yan and Xu and the brick and stone works along the river.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 40 major repairs were made to the dams at Yan and Xu and the riverside brick and stonework.

sentences.zh: 先是上以清口倒灌，詔循康熙中張鵬翮所開陶庄引河舊跡挑挖，導黃使北，遣鄂爾泰偕斌往勘，以汛水驟至而止。

translations.literal: Earlier, because of backflow at Qingkou, the emperor ordered dredging along the old trace of the Taozhuang diversion opened by Zhang Penghe in Kangxi times to guide the Yellow River north; Ortai and Bin were sent to survey, but work stopped when flood season water came suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because of backflow at Qingkou, the emperor ordered dredging along the old Taozhuang diversion trace opened by Zhang Penghe in Kangxi times to divert the Yellow River north. Ortai and Bin were sent to survey, but work stopped when flood-season water arrived suddenly.

sentences.zh: 旋完顏偉繼斌為河督，慮引河不易就，乃用斌議，自清口迤西，設木龍挑溜北趨，而陶庄終不敢議。

translations.literal: Soon Wanyan Wei succeeded Bin as River Director; fearing the diversion channel would be hard to complete, he adopted Bin's plan to set wooden dragons west of Qingkou to deflect the current north, but Taozhuang was never again proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wanyan Wei succeeded Bin as River Director. Fearing the diversion would be hard to complete, he adopted Bin's plan to set wooden deflectors west of Qingkou to turn the current north, but Taozhuang was never proposed again.

sentences.zh: 次年，南河督吳嗣爵內召，極言倒灌為害。

translations.literal: The next year Southern Rivers Director Wu Sijue was summoned to court and spoke urgently of the harm of backflow.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Southern Rivers Director Wu Sijue was summoned to court and urgently reported the harm caused by backflow.

sentences.zh: 薩載繼任，亦主改口議。

translations.literal: Sa Zai succeeded to the post and also advocated changing the outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai succeeded him and also advocated changing the river outlet.

sentences.zh: 上乃決意開之。

translations.literal: The emperor then resolved to open it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then resolved to open it.

sentences.zh: 於是清口東西壩基移下百六十丈之平成台，築攔黃壩百三十丈，並於陶庄迤北開引河，使黃離清口較遠，清水暢流，有力攻刷淤沙。

translations.literal: Thereupon the foundations of the eastern and western dams at Qingkou were moved down one hundred sixty zhang to Pingcheng Terrace, a Yellow River-blocking dam of one hundred thirty zhang was built, and a diversion channel was opened north of Taozhuang so the Yellow River stood farther from Qingkou, clear water flowed freely, and had force to scour silt.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern and western dam foundations at Qingkou were moved down 160 zhang to Pingcheng Terrace, a 130-zhang Yellow River-blocking dam was built, and a diversion channel was opened north of Taozhuang so the Yellow River stood farther from Qingkou, clear water could flow freely, and scour silt with force.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，引河成，黃流直注周家莊，會清東下，清口免倒灌之患者近十年。

translations.literal: In the second month of the next year the diversion was completed; the Yellow River flowed straight to Zhoujiazhuang, met clear water flowing east, and Qingkou was spared backflow for nearly ten years.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the following year the diversion was completed. The Yellow River flowed straight to Zhoujiazhuang, met the clear current flowing east, and Qingkou was spared backflow for nearly ten years.

sentences.zh: 五十年，洪湖旱涸，黃流淤及清口，命河南巡撫畢沅祭淮瀆，疏賈魯、惠濟諸河流以助清，湖水仍不出，黃復內灌。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year Hongze Lake dried in drought; Yellow River silt reached Qingkou; Henan Governor Bi Yuan was ordered to sacrifice at the Huai channel and dredge the Jia Lu, Huiji, and other rivers to aid clear water, but lake water still would not issue and the Yellow River again poured in.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 Hongze Lake dried in drought and Yellow River silt reached Qingkou. Henan Governor Bi Yuan was ordered to sacrifice at the Huai channel and dredge the Jia Lu, Huiji, and other rivers to aid clear water, but lake water still would not discharge and the Yellow River backed in again.

sentences.zh: 上欲開毛城鋪、王家營減壩，下大學士阿桂等議。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to open the reduction dams at Maochengpu and Wangjiaying and sent the matter down to Grand Secretary Agui and others for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to open the reduction dams at Maochengpu and Wangjiaying and referred the matter to Grand Secretary Agui and others.

sentences.zh: 阿桂言：「欲治清口之病，必去老壩工以下之淤，尤當掣低黃水，使清水暢出攻沙，不勞自治。」

translations.literal: Agui said: "To cure Qingkou's ailment, silt below the old dam works must be removed, and above all the Yellow River must be drawn lower so clear water can issue freely and scour sand—the problem will right itself without forced effort."
translations.idiomatic: Agui said: "To cure Qingkou's ailment, silt below the old dam works must be removed, and above all the Yellow River must be drawn lower so clear water can issue freely and scour sand—the problem will right itself without forced effort."

sentences.zh: 於是閉張福口四引河，浚通湖支河，蓄清水至七尺以上，治開王營壩減泄黃水，盡啟諸河，出清口滌沙，修清口兜水壩，易名束清壩。

translations.literal: Thereupon the four diversion channels at Zhangfukou were closed, lake branch rivers dredged and opened, clear water stored to more than seven chi, Wangying reduction dam opened to release Yellow River water, all channels fully opened, clear water issued at Qingkou to wash sand, the Qingkou water-catching dam was repaired and renamed the Clear-Water Retention Dam.
translations.idiomatic: The four diversion channels at Zhangfukou were closed, lake branch rivers dredged, clear water stored above seven chi, the Wangying reduction dam opened to release Yellow River water, all channels opened, clear water issued at Qingkou to wash sand, the Qingkou water-catching dam was repaired and renamed the Clear-Water Retention Dam.

sentences.zh: 復移下惠濟祠前之東西束水壩三百丈於福神巷前，加長東壩以御黃，縮短西壩以出清，易名御黃壩。

translations.literal: The eastern and western clear-water retention dams three hundred zhang before the Huiji Temple were moved down before Fushen Lane; the eastern dam was lengthened to repel the Yellow River and the western shortened to release clear water, and the name was changed to Yellow River-Control Dam.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern and western clear-water retention dams before the Huiji Temple were moved down 300 zhang to Fushen Lane; the eastern dam was lengthened to repel the Yellow River and the western shortened to release clear water, and the structure was renamed the Yellow River-Control Dam.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，湖水弱，清低於黃者丈餘，淮遏不出。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing year 1 lake water was weak; clear water stood more than one zhang below the Yellow River, and the Huai was blocked from issuing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing lake water was weak; clear water stood more than a zhang below the Yellow River, and the Huai was blocked from discharging.

sentences.zh: 淮漲則開山盱五壩、吳城七堡，黃漲或減水入湖，以救清口之倒灌。

translations.literal: When the Huai rose the five Shanxu dams and seven Wucheng forts were opened; when the Yellow rose, reduction dams might release water into the lake to relieve backflow at Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Huai rose, the five dams at Shanxu and the seven forts at Wucheng were opened; when the Yellow rose, reduction dams might release water into the lake to relieve backflow at Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 五年，用江督費淳、河督吳璥言，開吳城七堡引渠，使泄湖水入黃，以減盛漲。

translations.literal: In year 5, acting on Yangtze Governor-General Fei Chun and Canal Governor Wu Jing, the Wucheng seven-forts diversion was opened to discharge lake water into the Yellow River and reduce excessive flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, acting on Yangtze Governor-General Fei Chun and Canal Governor Wu Jing's proposal, the diversion channel at Wucheng's seven forts was opened to discharge lake water into the Yellow River and reduce excessive flooding.

sentences.zh: 八年，黃流入海不暢，直注洪澤湖。

translations.literal: In year 8 the Yellow River's passage to the sea was obstructed and it poured straight into Hongze Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Yellow River's passage to the sea was obstructed, and it poured straight into Hongze Lake.

sentences.zh: 璥赴海口相度，請力收運口各壩，止留口門，清雖力弱難出，黃亦不能再入。

translations.literal: Jing went to the estuary to survey and requested vigorously closing all dams at the transport junction, leaving only the outlet gates—clear water, though too weak to issue freely, could at least keep the Yellow River from entering again.
translations.idiomatic: Jing went to survey the river mouth and requested vigorously closing all dams at the transport junction, leaving only the outlet gates—clear water, though too weak to issue freely, could at least keep the Yellow River from entering again.

sentences.zh: 七月，淮漲，高堰危甚，開信、義兩壩泄水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Huai swelled; the high weir was in grave danger, and the Xin and Yi dams were opened to release water.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Huai swelled; the high weir was in grave danger, and the Xin and Yi dams were opened to release water.

sentences.zh: 西風大作，壞仁、智兩壩，淮南奔清口。

translations.literal: A strong west wind arose; the Ren and Zhi dams were destroyed, and the Huai south of the embankments rushed toward Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: A strong west wind arose; the Ren and Zhi dams were destroyed, and the Huai south of the embankments rushed toward Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 上責璥，遂罷免。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached Jing and dismissed him from office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reproached Jing and dismissed him from office.

sentences.zh: 九年春，湖水稍發，伏汛黃仍倒灌。

translations.literal: In the spring of year 9 lake water issued somewhat, but during the summer flood season the Yellow River still backed in.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year lake water issued somewhat, but during the summer flood season the Yellow River still backed in.

sentences.zh: 河督徐端以束清壩在運口北，分溜入運，致不敵黃，請移建湖口迤南。

translations.literal: Canal Governor Xu Duan held that the Clear-Water Retention Dam north of the transport junction diverted flow into the canal and left clear water unable to match the Yellow River; he asked to rebuild it south of the lake outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Canal Governor Xu Duan argued that the Clear-Water Retention Dam north of the transport junction diverted flow into the canal and left clear water unable to match the Yellow River; he asked to rebuild it south of the lake outlet.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，江督鐵保言：「潘季馴、靳輔治河，專力清口，誠以清口暢出，則河腹刷深，海口亦順，洪澤亦不致泛濫。

translations.literal: In year 11 Yangtze Governor-General Tie Bao said: "Pan Jixun and Jin Fu devoted their river works to Qingkou—rightly so, for when Qingkou discharges freely the river channel scours deeper, the estuary runs smoothly, and Hongze need not flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Yangtze Governor-General Tie Bao said: "Pan Jixun and Jin Fu devoted their river works to Qingkou—rightly so, for when Qingkou discharges freely the river channel scours deeper, the estuary runs smoothly, and Hongze need not overflow.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，大修閘壩，借清刷沙，不能不多蓄湖水。

translations.literal: For the present plan, sluices and dams must be heavily repaired, clear water used to scour sand, and lake water stored in greater volume—there is no avoiding it.
translations.idiomatic: For the present plan, sluices and dams must be heavily repaired, clear water must be used to scour sand, and lake water must be stored in greater volume—there is no avoiding it.

sentences.zh: 即不能不保護石堤，尤不能不急籌去路。」

translations.literal: Nor can stone embankments go unprotected; above all, outlets for discharge must be urgently planned."
translations.idiomatic: Nor can stone embankments go unprotected; above all, outlets for discharge must be urgently planned."

sentences.zh: 又偕徐端陳河工數事：一，外河廳之方家馬頭及三老壩為淮、揚保障，宜填護碎石；

translations.literal: He also joined Xu Duan in submitting several river works: first, Fangjiamatou and the Three Old Dams in the outer-river office district, bulwarks of Huai and Yangzhou, should be filled and armored with rubble;
translations.idiomatic: He also joined Xu Duan in submitting several river projects: first, Fangjiamatou and the Three Old Dams in the outer-river office district, bulwarks of Huai and Yangzhou, should be filled and armored with rubble;

sentences.zh: 一，義壩宜堵築；

translations.literal: second, the Yi dam should be closed and rebuilt;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Yi dam should be closed and rebuilt;

sentences.zh: 一，仁、智、禮、信四壩殘損宜拆修。

translations.literal: third, the four Ren, Zhi, Li, and Xin dams, damaged in parts, should be dismantled and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: third, the four Ren, Zhi, Li, and Xin dams, damaged in places, should be dismantled and repaired.

sentences.zh: 廷議如所請。

translations.literal: The court deliberation granted the requests.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberation granted the requests.

sentences.zh: 上恐四壩同修，清水過泄，命次第舉行。

translations.literal: The emperor feared that repairing all four dams at once would discharge too much clear water and ordered them carried out in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor feared that repairing all four dams at once would discharge too much clear water and ordered them carried out in sequence.

sentences.zh: 十五年十月，大風激浪，義壩決，堰、盱兩工掣坍千餘丈。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, tenth month, gale-driven waves breached the Yi dam and tore more than a thousand zhang from the works at Yan and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, tenth month, gale-driven waves breached the Yi dam and tore more than a thousand zhang from the works at Yan and Xu.

sentences.zh: 議者謂宜築碎石坦坡，以費鉅不果。

translations.literal: Some proposed building rubble-covered gentle slopes, but the cost was deemed too great and the plan was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Some proposed building rubble-covered gentle slopes, but the cost was deemed too great and the plan was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 璥與端請加培大堤外靳輔所築二堤，以為重門保障，亦為廷議所駁。

translations.literal: Jing and Xu Duan asked to heighten the two embankments Jin Fu had built outside the main dike as a second line of defense; the court discussion also rejected this.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Xu Duan asked to heighten the two embankments Jin Fu had built outside the main dike as a second line of defense; the court discussion also rejected this.

sentences.zh: 及陳鳳翔督南河，復申二堤之請。

translations.literal: When Chen Fengxiang took charge of the Southern Canal, he renewed the request for the two embankments.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Fengxiang took charge of the Southern Canal, he renewed the request for the two embankments.

sentences.zh: 下江督百齡議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to Yangtze Governor-General Bai Ling for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to Yangtze Governor-General Bai Ling for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 百齡言不若培修大堤。

translations.literal: Bai Ling said strengthening the main dike was preferable.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling said strengthening the main dike was preferable.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遣協辦大學士松筠履勘，亦主百齡議。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Coordinating Grand Secretary Songyun was sent on an inspection tour and also upheld Bai Ling's view.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Coordinating Grand Secretary Songyun was sent on an inspection tour and also upheld Bai Ling's view.

sentences.zh: 於是築大堤子堰，自束清壩尾至信壩迤南止。

translations.literal: Thereupon a subsidiary weir was built along the main dike from the end of the Clear-Water Retention Dam southward to the Xin Dam.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon a subsidiary weir was built along the main dike from the end of the Clear-Water Retention Dam southward to the Xin Dam.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔以不知蓄清於湖未漲之先，即啟智、禮兩壩，致禮壩潰，下游淹，清水消耗，貽誤全河，為百齡所劾，奪職遣戍。

translations.literal: Fengxiang was impeached by Bai Ling for opening the Zhi and Li dams before clear water was stored while the lake had not yet risen, causing the Li dam to burst, flooding downstream, depleting clear water, and harming the whole river system; he was stripped of office and sent into exile.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang was impeached by Bai Ling for opening the Zhi and Li dams before clear water was stored while the lake had not yet risen, causing the Li dam to burst, flooding downstream, depleting clear water, and harming the whole river system; he was stripped of office and sent into exile.

sentences.zh: 十八年，百齡及南河督黎世序以仁、義、禮三壩屢經開放，壞基跌塘，請移建三壩於蔣家壩南近山岡處，各挑引河，先建仁、義壩，因禮壩基改築草壩，備本年宣洩。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Bai Ling and Southern Canal Governor Li Shixu reported that the Ren, Yi, and Li dams, opened repeatedly, had ruined foundations and scoured plunge pools; they asked to relocate the three dams to a hilly site south of Jiangjiaba, each with a diversion channel, building Ren and Yi first and replacing the Li foundation with a straw dam for that year's release.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Bai Ling and Southern Canal Governor Li Shixu reported that the Ren, Yi, and Li dams, opened repeatedly, had ruined foundations and scoured plunge pools; they asked to relocate the three dams to a hilly site south of Jiangjiaba, each with a diversion channel, building Ren and Yi first and replacing the Li foundation with a straw dam for that year's release.

sentences.zh: 上命先建義壩，如節宣得宜，再分年遞修。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Yi dam built first; if regulation proved satisfactory, the rest would be repaired year by year.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Yi dam built first; if regulation proved satisfactory, the rest would be repaired year by year.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，增建束清二壩於束清壩北，收蓄湖水。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year a second Clear-Water Retention dam was added north of the first to store lake water.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year a second Clear-Water Retention dam was added north of the first to store lake water.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，增修高堰石工。

translations.literal: In Daoguang year 2 the stone works of the high weir were further repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 the stone works of the high weir were further repaired.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，河漲，洪澤湖蓄水至丈七尺，尚低於黃尺許，高堰十三堡堤頂被大水掣動，山盱周橋之息浪菴亦過水八九尺，各壩均有坍損。

translations.literal: In the winter of year 4 the river rose; Hongze stored water to 1.7 zhang yet still stood about a chi below the Yellow River; the crest of the thirteen forts at the high weir was torn by flood, Xilang'an at Zhouqiao in Shanxu took eight or nine chi of water, and every dam suffered damage.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year the river rose; Hongze Lake stored water to 1.7 zhang yet still stood about a chi below the Yellow River; the crest of the thirteen forts at the high weir was torn by flood, Xilang'an at Zhouqiao in Shanxu took eight or nine chi of water, and every dam suffered damage.

sentences.zh: 上遣尚書文孚、汪廷珍履勘，而褫河督張文浩職。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Ministers Wen Fu and Wang Tingzhen on inspection and dismissed Canal Governor Zhang Wenhao.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Ministers Wen Fu and Wang Tingzhen on inspection and dismissed Canal Governor Zhang Wenhao from office.

sentences.zh: 十三堡缺口旋塞。

translations.literal: The breach at the thirteen forts was soon closed.
translations.idiomatic: The breach at the thirteen forts was soon closed.

sentences.zh: 侍郎硃士彥言：「高堰石工在事諸臣，惟務節省，辦理草率。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zhu Shiyan said: "In the high-weir stone works the officials concerned sought only economy and executed the work carelessly.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zhu Shiyan said: "In the high-weir stone works the officials concerned sought only economy and executed the work carelessly.

sentences.zh: 又因搶築大堤，就近二堤取土，事後亦不培補。

translations.literal: They also took earth from the nearby secondary dikes for emergency repairs to the main dike and did not restore them afterward.
translations.idiomatic: They also took earth from the nearby secondary dikes for emergency repairs to the main dike and did not restore them afterward.

sentences.zh: 至山盱五壩，宣洩洪湖盛漲，未能謹守舊章，相機開放，致石工掣卸。」

translations.literal: As for the five Shanxu dams, meant to release Hongze's peak floods, they failed to observe the old regulations and open according to conditions, so the stone works were torn away."
translations.idiomatic: As for the five Shanxu dams, meant to release Hongze's peak floods, they failed to observe the old regulations and open according to conditions, so the stone works were torn away."

sentences.zh: 並下文孚等勘覈。

translations.literal: The memorial was also sent down to Wen Fu and others to verify on inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was also sent down to Wen Fu and others to verify on inspection.

sentences.zh: 明年春，從文孚等議，改湖堤土坦坡為碎石，於仁、義、禮舊壩處所各增建石滾壩，以防異漲。

translations.literal: The following spring, following Wen Fu's recommendation, earthen slopes on the lake dike were converted to rubble, and roller dams of stone were added at the old Ren, Yi, and Li dam sites against extraordinary floods.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring, following Wen Fu's recommendation, earthen slopes on the lake dike were converted to rubble, and stone roller dams were added at the old Ren, Yi, and Li dam sites against extraordinary floods.

sentences.zh: 八年，上以御黃壩上下積淤丈餘，清水不能多蓄，御黃壩終不可開，下南總河張井等籌議。

translations.literal: In year 8 the emperor noted more than a zhang of silt above and below the Yellow River-Control Dam, clear water could not be stored in quantity, and that dam could never be opened; he sent the matter to Southern Canal Director-General Zhang Jing and others for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the emperor noted more than a zhang of silt above and below the Yellow River-Control Dam, clear water could not be stored in quantity, and that dam could never be opened; he referred the matter to Southern Canal Director-General Zhang Jing and others for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 井等言：「乾隆間湖高於河七八尺或丈餘，入夏拆展御黃壩，洩清刷淤，至冬始閉。

translations.literal: Jing and others said: "Under Qianlong the lake stood seven or eight chi, sometimes more than a zhang, above the river; in summer the Yellow River-Control Dam was dismantled and extended to release clear water and scour silt, and was closed only in winter.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and others said: "Under Qianlong the lake stood seven or eight chi, sometimes more than a zhang, above the river; in summer the Yellow River-Control Dam was dismantled and extended to release clear water and scour silt, and was closed only in winter.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，因河淤，改夏閉秋啟。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing, because the river had silted, the practice was changed to closing in summer and opening in autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing, because the river had silted, the practice was changed to closing in summer and opening in autumn.

sentences.zh: 而黃水偶漲，即行倒灌。

translations.literal: Yet whenever the Yellow rose even briefly, backflow followed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Yet whenever the Yellow rose even briefly, backflow followed at once.

sentences.zh: 今積淤日久，縱清水能出，止高於黃數寸及尺餘，暫開即閉，僅免倒灌，未能收刷淤之效。」

translations.literal: Now silt has accumulated for years; even if clear water can issue, it stands only a few cun or a chi or so above the Yellow; the dam is opened briefly then closed—enough to avoid backflow but not to scour silt effectively."
translations.idiomatic: Now silt has accumulated for years; even if clear water can issue, it stands only a few cun or a chi or so above the Yellow; the dam is opened briefly then closed—enough to avoid backflow but not to scour silt effectively."

sentences.zh: 上不懌，曰：「以昔證今，已成不可救藥之勢。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased and said: "Judging the present by the past, the situation has become incurable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased and said: "Judging the present by the past, the situation has become incurable.

sentences.zh: 為河督者，祗知洩清水以保堰，閉御壩以免倒灌，增工請帑，但顧目前，不思經久，如國計何？

translations.literal: Canal governors know only to release clear water to protect the weir and close the control dam to prevent backflow, adding works and requesting funds while caring for the moment alone and not for the long term—what of state finances?
translations.idiomatic: Canal governors know only to release clear water to protect the weir and close the control dam to prevent backflow, adding works and requesting funds while caring for the moment alone and not for the long term—what of state finances?

sentences.zh: 如民生何？

translations.literal: What of the people's livelihood?
translations.idiomatic: What of the people's livelihood?

sentences.zh: 如後日何？」

translations.literal: What of days to come?"
translations.idiomatic: What of days to come?"

sentences.zh: 十年，井言：「淮水歸海之路不暢，請於揚糧廳之八塔鋪、商家溝各斜挑一河，匯流入江，分減漲水，並拆除芒稻河東西閘，挑挖淤灘，可抵新辟一河之用。」

translations.literal: In year 10 Jing said: "The Huai's path to the sea is obstructed. I propose cutting diversion channels at Batapu and Shangjiagou in the Yangzhou grain office district to join the Yangtze and split flood peaks, and removing the eastern and western sluices of the Mangdao River while dredging silt bars—equal to opening a new channel."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Jing said: "The Huai's path to the sea is obstructed. I propose cutting diversion channels at Batapu and Shangjiagou in the Yangzhou grain office district to join the Yangtze and split flood peaks, and removing the eastern and western sluices of the Mangdao River while dredging silt bars—equal to opening a new channel."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年，移建信壩於夏家橋。

translations.literal: In year 12 the Xin dam was relocated to Xiajiaqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the Xin dam was relocated to Xiajiaqiao.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以義字引河跌深三四丈，堵閉不易，允河督麟慶請，改挑義字河頭。

translations.literal: In year 14, because the Yi-character diversion had scoured three or four zhang deep and was hard to close, Canal Governor Lin Qing's request was granted to recut the head of the Yi-character channel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, because the Yi-character diversion had scoured three or four zhang deep and was hard to close, Canal Governor Lin Qing's request was granted to recut the head of the Yi-character channel.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，河決祥符，奪溜注洪澤湖，而江潮盛漲，又復頂托，因拆展御黃、束清及禮、智、仁各壩，並啟放車邏等壩，以泄湖水。

translations.literal: In year 21 the river breached at Xiangfu; the diverted current poured into Hongze, tidal floods on the Yangtze backed it up again, and the Yellow River-Control, Clear-Water Retention, and Li, Zhi, and Ren dams were dismantled and extended, along with Cheli and other dams, to release lake water.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the river breached at Xiangfu; the diverted current poured into Hongze Lake, tidal floods on the Yangtze backed it up again, and the Yellow River-Control, Clear-Water Retention, and Li, Zhi, and Ren dams were dismantled and extended, along with Cheli and other dams, to release lake water.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，河決中牟，全溜下注洪澤湖，高堰石工掣卸四千餘丈，先後拆展束清、御黃、智、信各壩，並啟放順清、禮、義等河，金灣舊壩及東西灣壩同時並啟，減水入江。

translations.literal: In year 23 the river breached at Zhongmou; the entire current poured into Hongze; more than four thousand zhang of high-weir stonework was torn away; the Clear-Water Retention, Yellow River-Control, Zhi, and Xin dams were opened in turn, along with the Shunqing, Li, and Yi channels, the old Jinwan dam, and the eastern and western bay dams together, reducing water into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the river breached at Zhongmou; the entire current poured into Hongze Lake; more than four thousand zhang of high-weir stonework was torn away; the Clear-Water Retention, Yellow River-Control, Zhi, and Xin dams were opened in turn, along with the Shunqing, Li, and Yi channels, the old Jinwan dam, and the eastern and western bay dams together, reducing water into the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 咸豐五年，河復決銅瓦廂，東注大清河入海。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng year 5 the river breached again at Tongwaxiang and flowed east via the Daqing River to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 5 the river breached again at Tongwaxiang and flowed east via the Daqing River to the sea.

sentences.zh: 黃河自北宋時一決滑州，再決澶州，分趨東南，合泗入淮。

translations.literal: Since the Northern Song the Yellow River broke once at Huazhou and again at Danzhou, dividing toward the southeast and joining the Si to enter the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Northern Song the Yellow River had broken once at Huazhou and again at Danzhou, dividing toward the southeast and joining the Si to enter the Huai.

sentences.zh: 蓋淮下游為河所奪者七百七十餘年，河病而淮亦病。

translations.literal: For more than seven hundred seventy years the Huai's lower reaches had been seized by the river; when the river was sick, the Huai was sick too.
translations.idiomatic: For more than seven hundred seventy years the Huai's lower reaches had been seized by the river; when the river was sick, the Huai was sick too.

sentences.zh: 至是北徙，江南之患息。

translations.literal: Now it shifted north and the calamity south of the Yangtze subsided.
translations.idiomatic: Now it shifted north, and the calamity south of the Yangtze subsided.

sentences.zh: 士民請復淮水故道者，歲有所聞。

translations.literal: Each year there were petitions from scholars and commoners to restore the Huai's old course.
translations.idiomatic: Each year there were petitions from scholars and commoners to restore the Huai's old course.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，江督馬新貽濬張福口引河，淮遂由清口達運。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi year 8 Yangtze Governor-General Ma Xinyi dredged the Zhangfukou diversion; the Huai then reached the Grand Canal via Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8 Yangtze Governor-General Ma Xinyi dredged the Zhangfukou diversion, and the Huai then reached the Grand Canal via Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 嗣又挑楊庄以下之淤黃河，以泄中運河盛漲。

translations.literal: Later the silted Yellow River channel below Yangzhuang was also cut to release floods on the Middle Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Later the silted Yellow River channel below Yangzhuang was also cut to release floods on the Middle Canal.

sentences.zh: 九年，新貽等言：「測量雲梯關以下河身，及成子河、張福口、高良澗一帶湖心，始知黃河底高於洪湖底一丈至丈五六尺不等，必先大濬淤黃，使淮得暢流入海，繼辟清口，導之入舊黃河，再堵三河，以杜旁洩而資抬蓄。

translations.literal: In year 9 Ma Xinyi and others said: "Surveying the channel below Yuntiguan and the lake bed at Chengzihé, Zhangfukou, and Gaoliangjian, we found the Yellow River bed one to one-and-a-half zhang higher than Hongze's; silted Yellow River must be heavily dredged so the Huai can reach the sea, then Qingkou opened to guide it into the old Yellow River channel, then the three rivers blocked to stop side leakage and aid storage.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Ma Xinyi and others said: "Surveying the channel below Yuntiguan and the lake bed at Chengzihé, Zhangfukou, and Gaoliangjian, we found the Yellow River bed one to one-and-a-half zhang higher than Hongze's; the silted Yellow River must be heavily dredged so the Huai can reach the sea, then Qingkou opened to guide it into the old Yellow River channel, then the three rivers blocked to stop side leakage and aid storage.

sentences.zh: 然非修復堰、盱石工，堅築運河兩堤，不敢遽堵三河、辟清口。

translations.literal: Yet without restoring the Yan and Xu stonework and solidly building both Grand Canal dikes, we dare not hastily block the three rivers or open Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Yet without restoring the Yan and Xu stonework and solidly building both Grand Canal dikes, we dare not hastily block the three rivers or open Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 統籌各工，非數百萬金不能集事。

translations.literal: Coordinating all works will require several million taels before they can be brought together.
translations.idiomatic: Coordinating all works will require several million taels before they can be brought together.

sentences.zh: 擬分別緩急，次第籌辦，不求利多，但求患減，為得寸得尺之計，收循序漸進之功。」

translations.literal: We propose sorting urgent from deferred tasks and proceeding step by step—seeking not great gain but reduced calamity, inch by inch, with gradual progress."
translations.idiomatic: We propose sorting urgent from deferred tasks and proceeding step by step—seeking not great gain but reduced calamity, inch by inch, with gradual progress."

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，江督劉坤一言：「臣此次周曆河湖，知淮揚水利有關國計民生。

translations.literal: In Guangxu year 7 Yangtze Governor-General Liu Kunyi said: "On this tour of rivers and lakes I have learned that Huai-Yang waterworks bear on state finances and people's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7 Yangtze Governor-General Liu Kunyi said: "On this tour of rivers and lakes I have learned that Huai-Yang waterworks bear on state finances and the people's livelihood.

sentences.zh: 前議導淮，未可中輟。

translations.literal: The plan to guide the Huai must not be abandoned midway.
translations.idiomatic: The plan to guide the Huai must not be abandoned midway.

sentences.zh: 自楊庄以下，舊黃河淤平，則山東昭陽、微山等湖之水，由中運河直趨南運河，夏秋之間，三閘甚形吃重。

translations.literal: Since the old Yellow River below Yangzhuang has silted level, water from Shandong's Zhaoyang, Weishan, and other lakes runs straight down the Middle Canal into the Southern Canal; in summer and autumn the three locks are heavily strained.
translations.idiomatic: Since the old Yellow River below Yangzhuang has silted level, water from Shandong's Zhaoyang, Weishan, and other lakes runs straight down the Middle Canal into the Southern Canal; in summer and autumn the three locks are heavily strained.

sentences.zh: 自洪澤湖淤淺，淮水不能合溜，北高於南，水之分入張福引河者無多，大溜由禮河徑趨高、寶等湖。

translations.literal: Hongze has shoaled; the Huai cannot gather its current; the north stands higher than the south; little water enters the Zhangfu diversion; the main current rushes via the Li channel toward Gaoyou and Baoying lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Hongze Lake has shoaled; the Huai cannot gather its current; the north stands higher than the south; little water enters the Zhangfu diversion; the main current rushes via the Li channel toward Gaoyou and Baoying lakes.

sentences.zh: 上年挑濬舊黃河後，山東蛟水屢次暴發，由此分瀉入海。

translations.literal: After last year's dredging of the old Yellow River, Shandong floodwaters erupted repeatedly and were split here to discharge to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: After last year's dredging of the old Yellow River, Shandong floodwaters erupted repeatedly and were split here to discharge to the sea.

sentences.zh: 築禮壩後，湖水瀦深，且由張福河入運口者頗旺。

translations.literal: After the Li dam was built, lake water pooled deeper, and the flow into the canal mouth via Zhangfu grew strong.
translations.idiomatic: After the Li dam was built, lake water pooled deeper, and the flow into the canal mouth via Zhangfu grew strong.

sentences.zh: 此挑舊河、築禮壩之不無微效也。

translations.literal: Thus dredging the old channel and building the Li dam have had some small effect.
translations.idiomatic: Thus dredging the old channel and building the Li dam have had some small effect.

sentences.zh: 惟是張福河淺，湖水仍趨重禮河越壩，終為可慮。

translations.literal: Yet Zhangfu remains shallow; lake water still favors the Li channel and overtopping the dam remains a worry.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhangfu remains shallow; lake water still favors the Li channel, and overtopping the dam remains a worry.

sentences.zh: 倘遇湖水汎濫，禮河即無越壩，亦難分消，必開信、智兩壩，由高寶湖入南運河，亦必開車邏、南關等壩，由里下河入海，沿途淹沒田廬，所損匪細。

translations.literal: If the lake floods, even without overtopping the Li channel cannot absorb it; the Xin and Zhi dams must open, sending water from Gaobao into the Southern Canal, and Cheli, Nanguan, and other dams must open to the sea via the Lixiahe—fields and homes flooded along the way at no small loss.
translations.idiomatic: If the lake floods, even without overtopping, the Li channel cannot absorb it; the Xin and Zhi dams must open, sending water from Gaobao into the Southern Canal, and Cheli, Nanguan, and other dams must open to the sea via the Lixiahe—fields and homes flooded along the way at no small loss.

sentences.zh: 今擬就張福河開挖寬深，以引洪澤湖之水，復挖碎石河，以分張福河之水，由吳城七堡匯順清河。

translations.literal: We now propose widening and deepening Zhangfu to draw Hongze water, reopening the rubble channel to split Zhangfu's flow, joining Shunqing via Wucheng's seven forts.
translations.idiomatic: We now propose widening and deepening Zhangfu to draw Hongze Lake water, reopening the rubble channel to split Zhangfu's flow, and joining Shunqing via Wucheng's seven forts.

sentences.zh: 水小則由順清入運，途紆而勢稍舒，水大則由舊黃河入海，途直而勢自順。

translations.literal: When water is low it enters the canal via Shunqing—the route is winding and the force gentler; when water is high it reaches the sea via the old Yellow River—the route is direct and the force naturally runs true.
translations.idiomatic: When water is low it enters the canal via Shunqing—the route is winding and the force gentler; when water is high it reaches the sea via the old Yellow River—the route is direct and the force naturally runs true.

sentences.zh: 約三四年間，便可告竣，所費尚不過鉅。

translations.literal: In about three or four years the work can be finished at no excessive cost.
translations.idiomatic: In about three or four years the work can be finished at no excessive cost.

sentences.zh: 議者或謂導淮入海，當盡瀉洪湖之水，有妨官運民田。

translations.literal: Some argue that guiding the Huai to the sea means draining Hongze entirely, harming grain transport and private fields.
translations.idiomatic: Some argue that guiding the Huai to the sea means draining Hongze entirely, harming grain transport and private fields.

sentences.zh: 臣以為別開引河，或不免有此患。

translations.literal: I hold that opening a separate diversion might indeed bring such harm.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that opening a separate diversion might indeed bring such harm.

sentences.zh: 今循張福河、碎石河故道以歸順清河，自非淮漲一二丈，則順清河之水何能高過中運河，溢出舊黃河？

translations.literal: Following Zhangfu and the rubble channel's old course back to Shunqing, unless the Huai rises one or two zhang, how could Shunqing's water stand above the Middle Canal and spill into the old Yellow River?
translations.idiomatic: Following Zhangfu and the rubble channel's old course back to Shunqing, unless the Huai rises one or two zhang, how could Shunqing's water stand above the Middle Canal and spill into the old Yellow River?

sentences.zh: 如使淮水暴漲，方有潰決之虞，惟恐水無去路，此正導淮之本意也。

translations.literal: If the Huai surged violently, there would indeed be fear of breach—but the very fear is that water has no outlet; that is precisely the purpose of guiding the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: If the Huai surged violently, there would indeed be fear of breach—but the very fear is that water has no outlet; that is precisely the purpose of guiding the Huai.

sentences.zh: 議者或謂多引湖水入運，恐三閘不能支持。

translations.literal: Others say drawing more lake water into the canal may overwhelm the three locks.
translations.idiomatic: Others say drawing more lake water into the canal may overwhelm the three locks.

sentences.zh: 不思洪湖未淤以前，湖水四平，蓄水深廣，張福以外，有四引河以濟漕運。

translations.literal: They forget that before Hongze shoaled the lake was level and deep; beyond Zhangfu four diversion channels aided transport.
translations.idiomatic: They forget that before Hongze shoaled the lake was level and deep; beyond Zhangfu four diversion channels aided transport.

sentences.zh: 維時黃未北徙，每遇漕船過閘，方且蓄清敵黃，以五引河全注運口，而三閘屹然，今特張福一河，決無致損三閘之理。

translations.literal: Then the Yellow had not shifted north; when transport fleets passed the locks clear water was stored to repel the Yellow—all five diversions poured into the canal mouth, yet the three locks stood firm; today with only Zhangfu, there is no reason the three locks should fail.
