translations.idiomatic: Then the Yellow had not shifted north; when transport fleets passed the locks clear water was stored to repel the Yellow—all five diversions poured into the canal mouth, yet the three locks stood firm; today with only Zhangfu, there is no reason the three locks should fail.

sentences.zh: 且上年挑通舊黃河，已分減中運河水，其入南運河者不過三四成。

translations.literal: Moreover last year's dredging of the old Yellow River already splits Middle Canal flow; what reaches the Southern Canal is scarcely thirty or forty percent.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover last year's dredging of the old Yellow River already splits Middle Canal flow; what reaches the Southern Canal is scarcely thirty or forty percent.

sentences.zh: 湖水雖增，與前略等，即遇大水，有舊黃河可以分減，亦不至專出三閘也。

translations.literal: Though lake water increases, it is much as before; even in great floods the old Yellow River can divide the volume—it need not all pass the three locks.
translations.idiomatic: Though lake water increases, it is much as before; even in great floods the old Yellow River can divide the volume—it need not all pass the three locks.

sentences.zh: 議者又謂如此，導淮無弊，亦屬無利，何必虛費帑藏。

translations.literal: Others again say that thus guided the Huai has neither harm nor benefit—why waste the treasury?
translations.idiomatic: Others again say that thus guided the Huai has neither harm nor benefit—why waste the treasury?

sentences.zh: 其說亦不盡然。

translations.literal: That view is not entirely so.
translations.idiomatic: That view is not entirely so.

sentences.zh: 夫治水之道，必須通盤規畫，並須預防變遷。

translations.literal: As for the way of controlling water, one must plan comprehensively and must guard against change in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The art of water control demands comprehensive planning and foresight against future shifts.

sentences.zh: 洪湖南有禮河，北有張福河，均為分泄淮水。

translations.literal: South of Hongze is the Li River; north is the Zhangfu River—both divide and discharge Huai water.
translations.idiomatic: South of Hongze Lake lies the Li River; to the north is the Zhangfu River—both serve to divert and discharge the Huai.

sentences.zh: 而水勢就下，禮河常苦水大，築禮河壩所以蓄張福之水，濬張福口所以顧禮河之堤，彼此互相維繫。

translations.literal: Water tends downward; the Li River often suffers from great volume. Building the Li River dam is to store Zhangfu's water; dredging Zhangfu's mouth is to protect the Li River dikes—they mutually sustain each other.
translations.idiomatic: Water seeks the lower course, so the Li River often bears too much flow. The Li River dam holds back water for Zhangfu; dredging Zhangfu's mouth protects the Li River dikes—the two works depend on each other.

sentences.zh: 如使禮河受全湖之沖，新壩恐不能保，續修則所費彌鉅，不修則為害滋深，下者益下，高者益高，張福河漸形壅塞矣。

translations.literal: If the Li River bore the full lake's rush, the new dam might not hold; continued repair would cost ever more, while if not repaired harm would deepen—the low would grow lower, the high higher, and Zhangfu River would gradually choke.
translations.idiomatic: If the Li River took the entire lake's force, the new dam might not stand; endless repairs would cost a fortune, yet leaving it unrepaired would deepen the damage—the low growing lower, the high higher, until Zhangfu River slowly silted shut.

sentences.zh: 且導淮之舉，原防盛漲肆虐。

translations.literal: Moreover the undertaking to guide the Huai was originally to guard against violent great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the whole purpose of guiding the Huai was to guard against catastrophic floods at peak rise.

sentences.zh: 如引湖由張福出順清，以舊黃河為出海之路，偶有泛溢，該處土曠人稀，趨避尚易。

translations.literal: If lake water were led out via Zhangfu to Shunqing, taking the old Yellow River as the route to sea, occasional overflow in that region of sparse land and people would still be easy to escape.
translations.idiomatic: If lake water were routed through Zhangfu to Shunqing and then down the old Yellow River to the sea, occasional overflow would hit open country with few people—evacuation would still be manageable.

sentences.zh: 若張福不暢，全湖之水折而南趨，則淮揚繁盛之區，億萬生靈將有其魚之嘆。

translations.literal: If Zhangfu were not open, all the lake's water would turn south—then in the prosperous Huai-Yang region countless lives would face the lament of becoming fish.
translations.idiomatic: If Zhangfu did not run freely and the whole lake turned south instead, the teeming Huai-Yang heartland and its millions would face the old cry of men becoming fish beneath the flood.

sentences.zh: 導淮之利，見於目前者猶小，見於日後者乃大也。」

translations.literal: The benefit of guiding the Huai appears small in the present but will prove great hereafter."
translations.idiomatic: The gains from guiding the Huai may look modest now, but they will prove far greater in years to come."

sentences.zh: 疏入，下部知之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the ministry was informed.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted, and the ministry took note.

sentences.zh: 八年，江督左宗棠言：「濬沂、泗為導淮先路，洵為確論。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Jiangsu-Governor Zuo Zongtang said: "Dredging the Yi and Si as the first path for guiding the Huai is indeed sound doctrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the governor-general of the Jiang provinces, Zuo Zongtang, wrote: "Dredging the Yi and Si rivers as the first step in guiding the Huai is sound doctrine.

sentences.zh: 惟云梯關以下二百餘里，河身高仰，且有遠年沙灘。

translations.literal: Yet below Yunti Pass for more than two hundred li the riverbed lies high and tilted upward, and there are sand bars of many years' standing.
translations.idiomatic: Yet for more than two hundred li below Yunti Pass the channel bed stands high and steep, littered with sandbars built up over many years.

sentences.zh: 昔以全黃之力所不能通者，今欲以沂、泗分流通之，其勢良難。

translations.literal: What once the full force of the Yellow could not penetrate, to expect the Yi and Si in divided flow to open it—the prospect is truly hard.
translations.idiomatic: What the full force of the Yellow River once could not cut through, one now hopes to open with only the divided flow of the Yi and Si—a very hard prospect indeed.

sentences.zh: 大通在雲梯關下十餘里，舊黃河北岸，系嘉慶中漫口，東北流四十餘里，至響水口，接連潮河，至灌河口入海。

translations.literal: Datong lies a little over ten li below Yunti Pass, on the north bank of the old Yellow River—it was a breach in the Jiaqing era; flowing northeast over forty li to Xiangshui mouth, joining the Chao River, reaching the sea at Guanhe mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Datong lies just over ten li below Yunti Pass on the north bank of the old Yellow River—a Jiaqing-era breach that ran northeast for forty-odd li to Xiangshui mouth, linked the Chao River, and reached the sea at Guanhe mouth.

sentences.zh: 就此加挑寬深，出海較便。

translations.literal: If dredged wider and deeper there, reaching the sea would be more convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Widening and deepening that stretch would make the outlet to sea far easier.

sentences.zh: 沂、泗來源，當大為分減，淮未復而運道亦可稍安，淮既復而歸海無虞阻滯。

translations.literal: The Yi and Si sources should be greatly reduced; before the Huai is restored the transport channel can be somewhat calmer, and once restored reaching the sea need not fear blockage.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi and Si headwaters should be sharply reduced: even before the Huai is restored the Grand Canal would gain some relief, and once restored the river could reach the sea without fear of obstruction.

sentences.zh: 此疏濬下游，宣洩沂、泗，實導淮先路，不可不亟籌者也。

translations.literal: This dredging the lower reach to discharge the Yi and Si is truly the first path for guiding the Huai and must be urgently planned.
translations.idiomatic: Clearing the lower reach to discharge the Yi and Si is the true first step in guiding the Huai—a matter that brooks no delay.

sentences.zh: 淮挾眾流，匯為洪澤，本江、皖巨浸。

translations.literal: The Huai, carrying many streams, gathers into Hongze—a great flooded region of Jiangsu and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai, gathering countless tributaries into Hongze Lake, was once a vast inland sea spanning Jiangsu and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 自道光間為黃所淤，北高南下，由禮河趨高寶湖以入運者垂三十年。

translations.literal: Since the Daoguang era it was silted by the Yellow; north high and south low, entering the canal via the Li River toward the Gaobao lakes has lasted nearly thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Daoguang era Yellow silt has left the lake higher in the north and lower in the south; for nearly thirty years the Huai has reached the canal only via the Li River into the Gaobao lakes.

sentences.zh: 今欲導之復故，不啻挽之逆流。

translations.literal: Today to guide it back to its old course is no less than pulling it against the current.
translations.idiomatic: To guide it back to its old course now is little short of forcing water uphill.

sentences.zh: 自張福口過大通、響水口入海，三百五十餘里，節節窒兒，非下游暢其去路，上游塞其漏卮，其不能舍下就高入黃歸海也明甚。

translations.literal: From Zhangfu mouth past Datong and Xiangshui mouth to the sea, over three hundred fifty li, section by section choked—unless the lower reach clears its outlet and the upper plugs its leaks, that it cannot abandon the low to seek the high and enter the Yellow to reach the sea is abundantly clear.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhangfu mouth by way of Datong and Xiangshui mouth to the sea is more than three hundred fifty li, choked at every stage—unless the lower course opens an outlet and the upper course stops every leak, it is plain that water cannot leave the low for the high, enter the Yellow, and reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 查張福口及天然引河，皆北趨陳家集之大沖，至碎石河以達吳城七堡，又北至順清河口，接楊庄舊黃河。

translations.literal: Investigation shows Zhangfu mouth and the natural diversion channel both run north toward the great Chong at Chenjiaji, reach Wucheng's seven forts via the rubble river, then north again to Shunqing mouth, joining Yangzhuang's old Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Survey shows that Zhangfu mouth and the natural diversion both run north to the great Chong at Chenjiaji, then via the rubble channel to Wucheng's seven forts, and north again to Shunqing mouth, where they join the old Yellow River at Yangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 張福河面六十餘丈，宜加寬深，天然河更須疏瀹，吳城七堡一帶高於張福河底丈六七尺，尤必大加挑濬，使湖水果能入黃，然後可堵禮河，以截旁趨之出路，堵順清河，以杜運河之奪河。

translations.literal: Zhangfu River's face is over sixty zhang wide—it should be widened and deepened; the natural channel especially needs dredging; the stretch at Wucheng's seven forts is one zhang six or seven chi above Zhangfu River's bed and must be greatly excavated so lake water can truly enter the Yellow—only then can the Li River be blocked to cut off side routes, and Shunqing River blocked to prevent the canal from stealing the channel.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangfu River is over sixty zhang across and should be widened and deepened; the natural channel needs dredging all the more. Near Wucheng's seven forts the bed stands one zhang six or seven chi above Zhangfu's bottom and must be cut down hard so lake water can truly enter the Yellow—only then can the Li River be sealed to block side escapes and Shunqing River closed to keep the Grand Canal from stealing the channel.

sentences.zh: 此引淮入海工程，當以次接辦者也。

translations.literal: This project to draw the Huai to the sea should be carried forward in due sequence.
translations.idiomatic: This work of drawing the Huai to the sea should be taken up step by step in proper order.

sentences.zh: 湖水不高，不能入黃。

translations.literal: If lake water is not high enough, it cannot enter the Yellow.
translations.idiomatic: If the lake level is too low, water cannot enter the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 太高，不特堰、盱石工可慮，運口閘壩難支，且於盱眙、五河近湖民田有礙。

translations.literal: If too high, not only the Yan and Xu stonework is at risk and the canal mouth locks and dams hard to sustain, but fields near the lake at Xuyi and Wuhe would suffer.
translations.idiomatic: If it is too high, not only are the Yan and Xu embankments at risk and the canal mouth locks hard to hold, but farmland near the lake at Xuyi and Wuhe would also suffer.

sentences.zh: 擬修復智、信等壩以泄湖漲，更建閘大沖，俾湖水操縱由人，多入淮而少入運。

translations.literal: It is proposed to restore the Zhi, Xin, and other dams to discharge lake floods, and further build a lock at Chong so lake water is controlled by human agency—more into the Huai, less into the canal.
translations.idiomatic: We propose restoring the Zhi, Xin, and other dams to bleed off lake floods, and building a sluice at Chong so the lake level can be managed deliberately—sending more water into the Huai and less into the canal.

sentences.zh: 此又預籌以善其後者也。」

translations.literal: This too is advance planning to manage what follows."
translations.idiomatic: This too is advance planning to handle what comes afterward."

sentences.zh: 三十四年，江督端方會勘淮河故道，力陳導淮四難，因於清江浦設局，遴紳籌議。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Jiangsu-Governor Duanfang jointly surveyed the Huai River's old channel, forcefully set forth four difficulties in guiding the Huai, and therefore established an office at Qingjiangpu, selecting gentry to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, Governor Duanfang of the Jiang provinces jointly inspected the Huai's old channel, argued forcefully for four difficulties in guiding the Huai, and set up an office at Qingjiangpu where selected local gentry were to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 久之無端緒，乃撤局。

translations.literal: After long with no progress, the office was dissolved.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time with no clear lead, the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，江蘇諮議局開，總督張人駿以導淮事列案交議，決定設江淮水利公司，先行測量，務使導淮復故，專趨入海。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, the Jiangsu Consultative Assembly opened; Governor-General Zhang Renjun placed the matter of guiding the Huai on the agenda; it was decided to establish the Jiang-Huai Water Conservancy Company, first to survey, aiming to restore the Huai to its old course and send it exclusively toward the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong the Jiangsu Consultative Assembly convened; Governor-General Zhang Renjun put guiding the Huai on the agenda. It was resolved to found the Jiang-Huai Water Conservancy Company, begin with surveying, and restore the Huai to its old course so it would run straight to the sea.

sentences.zh: 二年，侍讀學士惲毓鼎以濱淮水患日深，上言：「自魏、晉以降，瀕淮田畝，類皆引水開渠，灌溉悉成膏腴。

translations.literal: In the second year, Academician Reader Yun Yuding, because flood disaster along the Huai grew daily deeper, memorialized: "Since Wei and Jin, fields along the Huai mostly drew water and dug channels for irrigation, all becoming fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Academician Reader Yun Yuding, alarmed that floods along the Huai were worsening by the day, memorialized: "Since Wei and Jin times, fields along the Huai mostly drew water and dug channels for irrigation until the land became rich cropland.

sentences.zh: 近則沿淮州縣，年報水災，浸灌城邑，漂沒田廬，自正陽至高、寶，盡為澤國，實緣近百年間，河身淤塞，下游不通，水無所歸，浸成汎濫。

translations.literal: Recently the prefectures and counties along the Huai report flood disaster yearly—cities inundated, fields and houses washed away; from Zhengyang to Gaobao all became a water country, truly because in the past century the riverbed silted, the lower reach did not flow, water had nowhere to go, and gradually overflow spread.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the Huai-border prefectures report floods every year—towns submerged, fields and homes swept away. From Zhengyang to Gaobao all has become a water wilderness, truly because over the past century the channel silted up, the lower reach would not run, water had nowhere to go, and inundation spread.

sentences.zh: 是則高堰壩之為害也。

translations.literal: Thus the harm of the Gaoyan dam.
translations.idiomatic: That is the harm done by the Gaoyan dam.

sentences.zh: 異時黃、淮合流，有南下之勢，治河者欲束淮以敵黃，故特堅築高堰壩頭，逼淮由天妃閘以濟運。

translations.literal: In former times when Yellow and Huai flowed together with a southward tendency, river controllers wished to bind the Huai to oppose the Yellow, and therefore specially built the Gaoyan dam head firm, forcing the Huai through Tianfei Lock to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: In earlier times, when the Yellow and Huai ran together with a southward thrust, river engineers tried to pin the Huai against the Yellow and so built the Gaoyan dam head solid, forcing the Huai through Tianfei Lock to feed the transport canal.

sentences.zh: 今黃久北徙，堰壩無所用之，當別籌入海之途。

translations.literal: Today the Yellow has long shifted north; the dam serves no use—we should plan another route to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Yellow has long shifted north; the dam no longer serves its purpose, and another route to the sea must be planned.

sentences.zh: 其道有二，以由清口西壩、鹽河至北潮河為便。

translations.literal: There are two routes; the convenient one is via Qingkou's west dam, the Salt River to the North Chao River.
translations.idiomatic: There are two possible routes; the more convenient runs from Qingkou's west dam along the Salt River to the North Chao River.

sentences.zh: 尾閭既暢，水有所歸，不獨潁、壽、鳳、泗永澹沈災，即高、寶、興、泰亦百年高枕矣。」

translations.literal: Once the tail outlet is clear and water has somewhere to go, not only will Ying, Shou, Feng, and Si forever ease submerged disaster—even Gaobao, Xing, and Tai can rest secure for a century."
translations.idiomatic: Once the lower outlet is open and water has somewhere to go, not only will Ying, Shou, Feng, and Si be freed from chronic flooding—even Gaobao, Xing, and Tai could sleep easy for a century."

sentences.zh: 事下江督張人駿、蘇撫程德全、皖撫硃家寶勘議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to Governor-General Zhang Renjun, Jiangsu Governor Cheng Dequan, and Anhui Governor Zhu Jiabao for survey and deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to Governor-General Zhang Renjun, Jiangsu Governor Cheng Dequan, and Anhui Governor Zhu Jiabao for survey and deliberation.

sentences.zh: 人駿等言：「正事測量，俟測勘竣，即遴員開辦。」

translations.literal: Renjun and others said: "Surveying is now underway; when survey is complete officials will be selected to begin work."
translations.idiomatic: Renjun and the others replied: "Survey work is under way; once the survey is finished, officials will be chosen to begin implementation."

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: Report received.
translations.idiomatic: The court took note of the report.

sentences.zh: 三年，御史石長信言：「導淮一舉，詢謀僉同。

translations.literal: In the third year, Censor Shi Changxin said: "The undertaking to guide the Huai—in consultation all are agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Censor Shi Changxin wrote: "On guiding the Huai, every consultation ends in unanimous agreement.

sentences.zh: 美國紅十字會亦擬遣工程師來華查勘。

translations.literal: The American Red Cross also plans to send engineers to China to survey.
translations.idiomatic: The American Red Cross also plans to send engineers to China for a survey.

sentences.zh: 則我之思患預防，尤不可緩。

translations.literal: Then our thinking ahead to prevent harm must be all the more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Our own efforts to think ahead and prevent disaster must be all the more urgent.

sentences.zh: 江蘇水利公司既允部撥費用，安徽亦應設局測量，以為消弭巨災之圖。」

translations.literal: Since the Jiangsu Water Conservancy Company has agreed to ministry funding, Anhui too should establish an office for survey, as a plan to forestall great disaster."
translations.idiomatic: Since the Jiangsu Water Conservancy Company has accepted ministry funding, Anhui should also set up a survey office as part of a plan to avert catastrophe."

sentences.zh: 下部議允之。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and approved.

sentences.zh: 導淮之舉，經始於同治六年。

translations.literal: The undertaking to guide the Huai began in the sixth year of Tongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The effort to guide the Huai began in the sixth year of the Tongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 時曾國籓督兩江，嘗謂「復瀆之大利，不敢謂其遽興，淮揚之大害，不可不思稍減」。

translations.literal: At that time Zeng Guofan was governor of the two Jiang circuits and once said: "The great profit of restoring the old channel—I dare not say it will rise quickly; the great harm to Huai-Yang cannot but be thought to reduce somewhat."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zeng Guofan governed the two Jiang provinces and said: "I dare not claim the great benefit of restoring the old channel will come quickly, but the great harm to Huai and Yangzhou cannot go unaddressed—we must at least ease it somewhat."

sentences.zh: 迨黃流北徙，言者益多，大要不出兩策。

translations.literal: When the Yellow shifted north, advocates grew more numerous; the gist fell into no more than two strategies.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Yellow River shifted north, advocates multiplied, but the debate still boiled down to two main strategies.

sentences.zh: 一謂宜堵三河，辟清口，濬舊河，排雲梯關，使由故道入海。

translations.literal: One held that the three rivers should be blocked, Qingkou opened, the old channel dredged, and Yunti Pass cleared so it would reach the sea by the old course.
translations.idiomatic: One camp held that the three diversion rivers should be sealed, Qingkou opened, the old channel dredged, and Yunti Pass cleared so the Huai could reach the sea along its former course.

sentences.zh: 一謂導淮當自上流始，洪澤湖乃淮之委，非淮之源，宜於上游辟新道，循睢、汴北行，使淮未注湖，中途已泄其半，再由桃源之成子河穿舊黃河，經中河雙金閘入鹽河，至安東入海，使全淮分南北二道，納少瀉多，淮患從此可減。

translations.literal: One held that guiding the Huai must begin upstream—Hongze Lake is the Huai's terminus, not its source; upstream a new channel should be opened following Su and Bian northward so that before the Huai reaches the lake half is already discharged midway, then through Taoyuan's Chenzi River pierce the old Yellow River, via the Middle River's Shuangjin Lock enter the Salt River, reach the sea at Andong—dividing the whole Huai into north and south channels, receiving less and releasing more, so Huai disaster could henceforth be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The other held that guiding the Huai must start upstream: Hongze Lake is where the Huai ends, not where it begins. A new channel should be cut upstream along the Su and Bian rivers northward so that before the Huai even reaches the lake half its volume is already discharged; then through Chenzi River at Taoyuan it would pierce the old Yellow River, pass Shuangjin Lock on the Middle Canal into the Salt River, and reach the sea at Andong—splitting the whole Huai into northern and southern courses that take in less and release more, so Huai floods could finally be eased.

sentences.zh: 二說所持各異。

translations.literal: The two views differed in what they upheld.
translations.idiomatic: The two schools disagreed on the essentials.

sentences.zh: 然同、光以來，濬成子、碎石、沂、泗等河，疏楊庄以下至雲梯關故道，固已小試其端。

translations.literal: Yet from Tongzhi and Guangxu, dredging Chenzi, rubble, Yi, Si and other rivers and clearing the old channel from Yangzhuang below to Yunti Pass had already tried the approach in small measure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns onward, dredging the Chenzi, rubble, Yi, and Si rivers and clearing the old channel from Yangzhuang down to Yunti Pass had already tested both approaches in modest ways.

sentences.zh: 卒之淮為黃淤，積數百年，已無經行之渠，由運入江，勢難盡挽，迄於國變，終鮮成功。

translations.literal: In the end the Huai was silted by the Yellow for accumulated centuries—there was no longer a channel it could run; drawing it through the canal into the Yangtze, the force was hard to turn back fully; down to the dynastic change, success was finally rare.
translations.idiomatic: In the end centuries of Yellow silt left the Huai without a passable channel; forcing it through the canal into the Yangtze was a current too strong to reverse. Down to the fall of the dynasty, little was ever truly achieved.

sentences.zh: 永定河亦名無定河，即桑乾下游。

translations.literal: The Yongding River is also called the Wuding River—it is the lower Sanggan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River, also known as the Wuding or "Restless" River, is the lower course of the Sanggan.

sentences.zh: 源出山西太原之天池，伏流至朔州、馬邑復出，匯眾流，經直隸宣化之西寧、懷來，東南入順天宛平界，逕盧師台下，始名盧溝河，下匯鳳河入海。

translations.literal: Its source rises at Heaven Pool in Taiyuan, Shanxi, runs hidden then emerges again at Shuozhou and Mayi, gathers many streams, passes through Xining and Huailai in Xuanhua, Zhili, enters Wanping in Shuntian southeast, passes below Lushitai and is first named the Lugou River; below it joins the Feng River and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: It rises at Heaven Pool near Taiyuan in Shanxi, runs underground, re-emerges at Shuozhou and Mayi, gathers tributaries, passes Xining and Huailai in Zhili's Xuanhua prefecture, and enters Wanping in Shuntian. Below Lushitai it first takes the name Lugou River; farther down it joins the Feng River and reaches the sea.

sentences.zh: 以其經大同合渾水東北流，故又名渾河，元史名曰小黃河。

translations.literal: Because it passes Datong where it joins the turbid Sanggan and flows northeast, it is also called the Hun River; the Yuan History calls it the Little Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Where it passes Datong and joins the muddy Sanggan it flows northeast and is also called the Hun River; the Yuan History names it the Little Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 從古未曾設官營治。

translations.literal: From antiquity no officials were appointed to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: Until modern times no government office was charged with managing it.

sentences.zh: 其曰永定，則康熙間所錫名也。

translations.literal: The name Yongding ("Forever Settled") was bestowed in the Kangxi era.
translations.idiomatic: The name Yongding, "Forever Settled," was granted in the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 永定河匯邊外諸水，挾泥沙建瓴而下，重巒夾峙，故鮮潰決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River gathers border waters, bearing sand and mud like water poured from a high jar; steep ranges press on both sides, so breaches were rare.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding gathers frontier streams and rushes down laden with sand and mud like water tipped from a rooftop jar; steep mountains hem it in on both sides, so breaches were rare.

sentences.zh: 至京西四十里石景山而南，逕盧溝橋，地勢陡而土性疏，縱橫蕩漾，遷徙弗常，為害頗鉅。

translations.literal: At forty li west of the capital at Shijingshan and south, passing Lugou Bridge—the ground is steep and the soil loose, surging and wandering without fixed course, the harm was quite great.
translations.idiomatic: But forty li west of the capital, from Shijingshan southward past Lugou Bridge, the slope steepens and the soil turns loose; the river surges and wanders without fixed course, and the damage grows severe.

sentences.zh: 於是建堤壩，疏引河，宣防之工亟焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon dikes and dams were built, diversion channels dredged, and flood-control work became urgent.
translations.idiomatic: There dikes and dams were built, diversion channels dredged, and flood-control work became urgent.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，河由永清徙固安，與白溝合。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi the river shifted from Yongqing to Gu'an and joined the Baigou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shunzhi the river shifted from Yongqing to Gu'an and joined the Baigou River.

sentences.zh: 明年，決口始塞。

translations.literal: The next year the breach was first closed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the breach was first closed.

sentences.zh: 十一年，由固安西宮村與清水合，經霸州東，出清河；

translations.literal: In the eleventh year it left Gu'an's Xigong Village and joined the Qing River, passing east of Bazhou and out at Qinghe;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year it left Xigong Village in Gu'an, joined the Qing River, passed east of Bazhou, and issued at Qinghe;

sentences.zh: 又決九花台、南里諸口，霸州西南遂成巨浸。

translations.literal: It again breached at Jiuhuatai, Nanli, and other mouths, and southwest Bazhou became a vast flood.
translations.idiomatic: It broke again at Jiuhuatai, Nanli, and other points, and southwest Bazhou became a vast inland sea.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年，決盧溝橋堤，命侍郎羅多等築之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi the Lugou Bridge dike broke; Vice Minister Luo Duo and others were ordered to build it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Kangxi the Lugou Bridge dike burst; Vice Minister Luo Duo and others were ordered to repair it.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，以河道漸次北移，永清、霸州、固安、文安時被水災，用直隸巡撫郭世隆議，疏永清東北故道，使順流歸淀。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, as the channel gradually shifted north and Yongqing, Bazhou, Gu'an, and Wen'an suffered flood yearly, following Zhili Governor Guo Shilong's proposal the old channel northeast of Yongqing was dredged so flow went smoothly to the marshes.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, as the channel drifted steadily north and Yongqing, Bazhou, Gu'an, and Wen'an suffered floods year after year, Zhili Governor Guo Shilong's plan was adopted: the old channel northeast of Yongqing was dredged so the river could run smoothly into the marshes.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，以保定以南諸水與渾水匯流，勢不能容，時有汎濫，聖祖臨視。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, because waters south of Baoding and the Hun River joining could not be contained and overflowed often, the Sacred Ancestor inspected in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year, because the streams south of Baoding and the muddy Hun could not be held in one channel and often spilled over, the Kangxi Emperor inspected the river in person.

sentences.zh: 巡撫于成龍疏築兼施，自良鄉老君堂舊河口起，逕固安北十里鋪、永清東南硃家莊，會東安狼城河，出霸州柳岔口三角淀，達西沽入海，濬河百四十五里，築南北堤百八十餘里，賜名永定。

translations.literal: Governor Yu Chenglong combined dredging and building from the old mouth at Laojuntang in Liangxiang through Gubei Shilipu in Gu'an, Zhujiazhuang southeast in Yongqing, joining Dong'an's Langcheng River, out at Bazhou's Liuchakou into the Sanjiao marshes and reaching Xigu to the sea—dredging 145 li of river, building over 180 li of north and south dikes—the name Yongding was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yu Chenglong combined dredging with dike-building from the old mouth at Laojuntang in Liangxiang through Shilipu north of Gu'an and Zhujiazhuang southeast of Yongqing, joining Dong'an's Langcheng River and issuing at Liuchakou in Bazhou into the Sanjiao marshes and on to Xigu and the sea. He dredged 145 li of channel and built more than 180 li of north and south dikes, and the river was granted the name Yongding.

sentences.zh: 自是渾流改注東北，無遷徙者垂四十年。

translations.literal: From then the turbid flow turned to pour northeast and did not shift for nearly forty years.
translations.idiomatic: From then the muddy current ran northeast and did not shift course for nearly forty years.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，郎城淀河淤且平，上游壅塞，命河督王新命開新河，改南岸為北岸，南岸接筑西堤，自郭家務起，北岸接築東堤，自何麻子營起，均至柳岔口止。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year Langcheng marsh river silted and level, the upper reach blocked; River Director Wang Xinming was ordered to open a new channel, turning the south bank into the north bank; the south bank continued the west dike from Guojiawu; the north bank continued the east dike from Hemazi Camp—both to Liuchakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year the Langcheng marsh channel silted nearly flat and the upper reach backed up. River Director Wang Xinming was ordered to cut a new channel, making the old south bank the north bank; the south bank's west dike was extended from Guojiawu and the north bank's east dike from Hemazi Camp, both ending at Liuchakou.

sentences.zh: 四十年，加築南岸排椿遙堤，修金門閘。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year the south bank's distant pile dikes were reinforced and the Jinmen Sluice repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year distant pile dikes on the south bank were strengthened and the Jinmen Sluice was repaired.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，決永清王虎庄，旋塞。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year Yongqing's Wanghuzhuang broke—it was soon closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year the dike broke at Wanghuzhuang in Yongqing and was soon closed again.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，修兩岸沙堤大堤，決賀堯營。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year both banks' sand and main dikes were repaired; Heyaoying broke.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year sand dikes and main dikes on both banks were repaired, but Heyaoying burst.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，復決賀堯營，隨塞。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year Heyaoying broke again and was promptly closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-first year Heyaoying broke again and was promptly sealed.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，修郭家務大堤，築清涼寺月堤，修金門閘，築霸州堂二鋪南堤決口。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng the Guojiawu main dike was repaired, Qingliang Temple moon dike built, Jinmen Sluice repaired, and the south dike breach at Bazhou Tang'erpupu closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng the main dike at Guojiawu was repaired, a moon dike built at Qingliang Temple, Jinmen Sluice restored, and the south dike breach at Tang'erpupu in Bazhou closed.

sentences.zh: 三年，因郭家務以下兩岸頓狹，永清受害特重，命怡親王允祥、大學士硃軾，引渾水別由一道入海，毋使入淀，遂於柳岔口少北改為下口，開新河自郭家務至長河，凡七十里，經三角淀達津歸海，築三角淀圍堤，以防北軼。

translations.literal: In the third year, because below Guojiawu both banks abruptly narrowed and Yongqing suffered especially heavily, Prince Yi Yunxiang and Grand Secretary Zhu Fushi were ordered to lead the Hun River by a separate channel to sea without entering the marshes; therefore slightly north of Liuchakou the outlet was changed, a new channel opened from Guojiawu to Changhe, 70 li in all, reaching Tianjin via the Sanjiao marshes and entering the sea; Sanjiao marsh ring dikes were built against northward spill.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, because the banks below Guojiawu narrowed sharply and Yongqing suffered especially hard, Prince Yi Yunxiang and Grand Secretary Zhu Fushi were ordered to send the muddy river to sea by a separate route and keep it out of the marshes. The outlet was moved slightly north of Liuchakou, a new channel cut from Guojiawu to Changhe for seventy li, reaching Tianjin through the Sanjiao marshes and then the sea, with ring dikes built around the marshes to block northward spill.

sentences.zh: 又築南堤自武家莊至王慶坨，北堤自何麻子營至范甕口，其冰窖至柳岔口堤工遂廢。

translations.literal: The south dike was built from Wujiazhuang to Wangqingtuo and the north dike from Hemazi Camp to Fankou; the dike works from Bingjiao to Liuchakou were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: A south dike was built from Wujiazhuang to Wangqingtuo and a north dike from Hemazi Camp to Fankou, while the dike works from Bingjiao to Liuchakou were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 十二年，決梁各庄、四聖口等處三百餘丈，黃家灣河溜全奪，水穿永清縣郭下注霸州之津水窪歸淀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Lianggezhuang, Sishengkou, and elsewhere broke for over 300 zhang; the Huangjiawan current was entirely seized; water pierced Yongqing's city wall below and through Bazhou's Jinshuipo returned to the marshes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year breaches opened at Lianggezhuang, Sishengkou, and elsewhere for more than three hundred zhang; the Huangjiawan current was wholly diverted; water cut through below Yongqing's city wall and via Bazhou's Jinshuipo back into the marshes.

sentences.zh: 總河顧琮督兵夫塞之。

translations.literal: Overall River Director Gu Zong supervised labor to close it.
translations.idiomatic: Overall River Director Gu Zong supervised troops and laborers in closing the breaches.

sentences.zh: 十三年，決南岸硃家莊、北岸趙家樓，水由六道口小堤仍歸三角淀。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the south bank's Zhujiazhuang and north bank's Zhaojialou broke; water via the Liudaokou small dike still returned to the Sanjiao marshes.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Zhujiazhuang on the south bank and Zhaojialou on the north bank burst; water still returned to the Sanjiao marshes by way of the small dike at Liudaokou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，總河劉勷勘修南北堤，開黃家灣、求賢庄、曹家新莊各引河，濬雙口、下口、黃花套。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong Overall River Director Liu Kan surveyed and repaired north and south dikes, opened diversion channels at Huangjiawan, Qiuxianzhuang, and Caojiaxinzhuang, and dredged Shuangkou, lower mouth, and Huanghuatao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong Overall River Director Liu Kan surveyed and repaired the north and south dikes, opened diversion channels at Huangjiawan, Qiuxianzhuang, and Caojiaxinzhuang, and dredged Shuangkou, the lower outlet, and Huanghuatao.

sentences.zh: 六月，漲漫南岸鐵狗、北岸張客等村四十餘處，奪溜由張客決口下歸鳳河。

translations.literal: In the sixth month floods spread over forty-odd villages including Tie'gou on the south bank and Zhangke on the north; the current was seized and went down through Zhangke's breach into the Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month floodwaters spread over more than forty villages, including Tie'gou on the south bank and Zhangke on the north; the main current was seized and ran down through the breach at Zhangke into the Feng River.

sentences.zh: 命吏部尚書顧琮察勘，請仿黃河築遙堤之法。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Gu Zong was ordered to survey and proposed following the Yellow River method of building distant dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Gu Zong was ordered to inspect the damage and proposed following the Yellow River practice of building distant protective dikes.

sentences.zh: 大學士鄂爾泰持不可，議「於北截河堤北改挑新河，以北堤為南堤，沿之東下，下游作泄潮埝數段，復於南北岸分建滾水石壩四，各開引河：一於北岸張家水口建壩，即以所沖水道為引河，東匯鳳河；

translations.literal: Grand Secretary E'ertai held it impossible and proposed: "North of the intercepting dike on the north bank open a new channel, taking the north dike as south dike and following it east; downstream build several tidal discharge embankments; further on north and south banks build four stone overflow dams each with a diversion channel: one on the north bank at Zhangjia mouth, using the scoured channel as diversion, east into Feng River;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Ertai objected and proposed instead: "North of the intercepting dike on the north bank, cut a new channel, treat the north dike as the south dike, and follow it east; downstream build several tidal discharge embankments; and on both banks erect four stone overflow dams, each with a diversion channel: one on the north bank at Zhangjia mouth, using the scoured channel as the diversion, east into the Feng River;

sentences.zh: 一於南岸寺台建壩，以民間泄水舊渠入小清河者為引河；

translations.literal: one on the south bank at Satai, using the old civilian drainage channel into the Xiaoqing River;
translations.idiomatic: one on the south bank at Satai, using the old civilian drainage channel that entered the Xiaoqing River;

sentences.zh: 一於南岸金門閘建壩，以渾河故道接檿牛河者為引河；

translations.literal: one on the south bank at Jinmen Sluice, using the Hun River's old channel joining the Zhenniu River;
translations.idiomatic: one on the south bank at Jinmen Sluice, using the old Hun River channel that joined the Zhenniu River;

sentences.zh: 一於南岸郭家務建壩，即以舊河身為引河。

translations.literal: one on the south bank at Guojiawu, using the old riverbed as diversion.
translations.idiomatic: one on the south bank at Guojiawu, using the old riverbed itself as the diversion channel.

sentences.zh: 合清隔濁，條理自明」。

translations.literal: Clear and turbid separated—the logic is self-evident."
translations.idiomatic: Clear water and muddy water kept apart—the plan is self-evident."

sentences.zh: 詔從其請。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 四年，直督孫嘉淦請移寺台壩於曹家務，張客壩於求賢庄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhili Governor Sun Jiaxing requested moving the Satai dam to Caojiawu and the Zhangke dam to Qiuxianzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Zhili Governor Sun Jiaxing asked to move the Satai dam to Caojiawu and the Zhangke dam to Qiuxianzhuang.

sentences.zh: 又於金門閘、長安城添築草壩，定以四分過水。

translations.literal: Grass dams were added at Jinmen Sluice and Chang'ancheng, fixed at one-quarter overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Grass overflow dams were also added at Jinmen Sluice and Chang'ancheng, set to pass one quarter of the flow.

sentences.zh: 顧琮言，金門閘、長安城兩壩水勢僅一河宣洩，恐汛發難容，擬分引河為兩股，一由南窪入中亭河，一由楊青口入津水窪。

translations.literal: Gu Zong said the two dams at Jinmen Sluice and Chang'ancheng had current that only one river could discharge—fearing floods could not be contained, he proposed splitting into two diversion channels, one via Nan'wa into the Zhongting River and one via Yangqing mouth into Jinshuipo.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Zong reported that at Jinmen Sluice and Chang'ancheng a single channel could barely carry the discharge and might fail in flood season; he proposed splitting the diversion into two branches, one through Nan'wa into the Zhongting River and one through Yangqing mouth into Jinshuipo.

sentences.zh: 又言郭家務、小梁村等處舊有遙河千七百丈，年久淤塞，請發帑興修。

translations.literal: He also said at Guojiawu, Xiaoliangcun, and elsewhere there was an old distant channel of 1,700 zhang long silted for years, and requested treasury funds for repair.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that near Guojiawu and Xiaoliangcun an old distant channel 1,700 zhang long had silted up over the years and asked that treasury funds be allocated for its restoration.

sentences.zh: 均從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，孫嘉淦請開金門閘重堤，濬西引河，開南堤，放水復行故道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Sun Jiaxing requested opening Jinmen Sluice's heavy dike, dredging the west diversion, opening the south dike, and releasing water to run the old course again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Sun Jiaxing asked to open the heavy dike at Jinmen Sluice, dredge the western diversion channel, open the south dike, and release water back into the old course.

sentences.zh: 六年，凌汛漫溢，固、良、新、涿、雄、霸各境多淹。

translations.literal: In the sixth year ice-flood overflow inundated much of Gu'an, Liangxiang, Xinhe, Zhuo, Xiong, and Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year spring ice floods spilled over and inundated much of Gu'an, Liangxiang, Xinhe, Zhuo, Xiong, and Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 從鄂爾泰議，堵閉新引河，展寬雙口等河，挑葛漁城河槽，築張客、曹家務月堤，改築郭家務等壩。

translations.literal: Following E'ertai's plan: the new diversion was blocked and closed, Shuangkou and other rivers widened, the Geyucheng channel excavated, Zhangke and Caojiawu moon dikes built, and Guojiawu and other dams rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: Following Ertai's plan, the new diversion was sealed off, Shuangkou and other channels were widened, the Geyucheng riverbed was excavated, moon dikes were built at Zhangke and Caojiawu, and the dams at Guojiawu and elsewhere were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 八年，濬新河下口，及董家河、三道河口，修新河南岸及鳳河以東堤埝。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the new channel's lower mouth and the Dongjia, Sandaohe, and other mouths were dredged, and dikes east of the new channel's south bank and the Feng River were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the lower outlet of the new channel was dredged, along with the Dongjia River, Sandaohe mouth, and other points, and dikes on the south bank of the new channel and east of the Feng River were repaired.

sentences.zh: 又疏穆家口以下至東蕭庄、鳳河邊二十里有奇。

translations.literal: Again dredged from below Mukou to Dongxiaozhuang and the Feng River margin, a little over twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: The channel was also dredged from below Mukou to Dongxiaozhuang and the Feng River bank, a distance of a little over twenty li.

sentences.zh: 九年，以范甕口下統以沙、葉兩淀為歸宿，兩汛水多歸葉淀，遂疏注沙淀路，並將南北舊減河濬歸鳳河。

translations.literal: In the ninth year below Fanweng Kou the system was made to take the Sha and Ye marshes as its outlet; floodwaters of both seasons mostly went to Ye Marsh, so the route to Sha Marsh was dredged and cleared, and old relief channels north and south were dredged back into the Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the reach below Fanweng Kou was arranged to discharge into the Sha and Ye marshes; water from both flood seasons mostly ran into Ye Marsh, so the route to Sha Marsh was cleared and the old relief channels on both banks were dredged back into the Feng River.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，河水驟漲，由南岸第四溝奪溜出，逕固安城下至牛坨，循黃家河入津水窪，一由檿牛河入中亭河。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year the river rose sharply; the current seized out through the south bank's fourth gully, passed below Gu'an city to Niutuo, followed Huangjia River into Jinshuipo, and one branch via Zhenniu River into Zhongting River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year the river rose abruptly; the main current broke out through the fourth gully on the south bank, ran below Gu'an city to Niutuo, followed the Huangjia River into Jinshuipo, while another branch entered the Zhongting River by way of the Zhenniu River.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎三和同直督堵御，於口門下另挑引河，截溜築壩，遏水南溢，使歸故道。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Sanhe and the Zhili governor were ordered jointly to block and defend; below the mouth a new diversion was excavated, the current intercepted and dams built to check southward overflow and return water to the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Sanhe and the Zhili governor were ordered to block the breach together; below the mouth they cut a new diversion channel, intercepted the current, built dams to hold back southward overflow, and sent the water back into the old course.

sentences.zh: 十六年，凌汛水發，全河奔注冰窖堤口，即於王慶坨南開引河，導經流入葉淀，以順水性。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year spring ice floods released; the whole river rushed to the Bingjiao dike mouth; immediately south of Wangqingtuo a diversion was opened to guide the flow into Ye Marsh, following the water's inclination.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the spring ice flood broke loose; the entire river surged toward the Bingjiao dike mouth; a diversion was opened just south of Wangqingtuo to lead the current into Ye Marsh in accord with the water's natural tendency.

sentences.zh: 十九年，南埝水漫堤頂，決下口東西老堤，奪溜南行，漫勝芳舊淀，逕永清之武家廠、三聖口，霸州之信安入口。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the south embankment flooded over the dike crown; the old east and west dikes at the lower outlet broke; the current seized southward, spread through Shengfang's old marsh, and via Yongqing's Wujia Factory and Sanshengkou and Bazhou's Xin'an mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year water on the south embankment topped the dike; the old east and west dikes at the lower outlet gave way; the main current was seized southward, spread through Shengfang's old marsh, and ran by way of Wujia Factory and Sanshengkou in Yongqing and the Xin'an mouth in Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，高宗臨視，改下游由調河頭入海，挑引河二十餘里，加培埝身二千二百餘丈。

translations.literal: The next year the Gaozong Emperor inspected in person; the lower course was changed to enter the sea via Tiaohe Tou; a diversion of more than twenty li was excavated and the embankment body raised by more than 2,200 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Gaozong Emperor inspected the works in person; the lower course was redirected to reach the sea through Tiaohe Tou; a diversion channel more than twenty li long was cut, and more than 2,200 zhang were added to the embankment body.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，直督方觀承請於北埝外更作遙堤，預為行水地，鳳河東堤亦接築至遙埝尾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Zhili Governor Fang Guancheng asked to build another distant dike outside the north embankment as reserved floodway, and the Feng River's east dike was continued to the end of the distant embankment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Zhili Governor Fang Guancheng proposed building a further distant dike outside the north embankment to reserve space for flood flow, and extending the Feng River's east dike to the end of the distant embankment.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，大雨，直隸各河並漲，下游悉歸淀內，大清河不能宣洩，轉由鳳河倒漾，阻遏渾流，南岸四工堤決。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year heavy rain caused all Zhili rivers to rise together; the lower course all ran into marshes; the Daqing River could not discharge; water backed up through the Feng River, blocking the muddy current, and the south bank's fourth-section dike broke.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year heavy rains raised every river in Zhili at once; the lower reach emptied entirely into the marshes; the Daqing River could not carry the discharge; water backed up through the Feng River and checked the muddy current, and the fourth-section dike on the south bank burst.

sentences.zh: 命御前侍衛赫爾景額協同直督剋日堵築。

translations.literal: Imperial Bodyguard He'er Jing'e was ordered to assist the Zhili governor in blocking and building on a set day.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Bodyguard He'er Jing'e was ordered to join the Zhili governor in closing the breach and rebuilding the dike within a fixed deadline.

sentences.zh: 三十五年、三十六年，兩岸屢決。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth and thirty-sixth years both banks broke repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth and thirty-sixth years breaches opened repeatedly on both banks.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，命尚書高晉、裘曰修偕直督周元理履勘，疏言：「永定河自康熙間築堤以來，凡六改道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year Ministers Gao Jin and Qiu Yuexiu were ordered with Zhili Governor Zhou Yuanli to survey on site and memorialized: "Since dikes were built in the Kangxi reign, the Yongding River has shifted course six times.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year Ministers Gao Jin and Qiu Yuexiu were sent with Zhili Governor Zhou Yuanli to inspect the river on site and reported: "Since dikes were first built in the Kangxi reign, the Yongding River has changed course six times.

sentences.zh: 救弊之法，惟有疏中洪、挑下口，以暢奔流，築岸堤以防衝突，濬減河以分盛漲。」

translations.literal: To remedy the harm there is only dredging the central channel, excavating the lower outlet to speed swift flow, building bank dikes against collision, and dredging relief rivers to divide peak floods."
translations.idiomatic: The only way to remedy the damage is to dredge the central channel, open the lower outlet to ease the swift current, build bank dikes against impact, and dredge relief channels to divide peak floods."

sentences.zh: 遂興大工，用帑十四萬有奇。

translations.literal: Thus a major project was undertaken, using a little over 140,000 taels from the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: A major project was then launched at a treasury cost of a little over 140,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 自是水由調河頭逕毛家窪、沙家淀達津入海。

translations.literal: From then on water ran from Tiaohe Tou via Maojiawa and Shajia Marsh to Tianjin and the sea.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the river ran from Tiaohe Tou through Maojiawa and Shajia Marsh to Tianjin and the sea.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，調河頭受淤，其澄清之水散漫而下，別由東安響水村直趨沙家淀。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year Tiaohe Tou silted; its clear water spread downward and separately ran straight from Dong'an's Xiangshui village to Shajia Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year Tiaohe Tou silted up; its clearer water spread downstream and separately ran straight from Xiangshui village in Dong'an to Shajia Marsh.

sentences.zh: 四十年，堵北三工、南頭工漫口。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year the north third-section and south head-section overflow breaches were closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year the overflow breaches at the north third section and the south head section were sealed.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，展築新北堤，加培舊越堤，廢去瀕河舊堤，使河身寬展。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year the new north dike was extended, the old transverse dike heightened, riverside old dikes abolished, and the river channel widened.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year the new north dike was extended, the old transverse dike was raised, the old riverside dikes were abandoned, and the river channel was widened.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，盧溝橋西岸漫溢，北頭工衝決，由良鄉之前官營散溢求賢村減河歸黃花店，爰開引溝八百丈，引溜歸河。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year the west bank at Lugou Bridge overflowed; the north head-section was breached; water spread from Liangxiang's Qiangguanying via Qiuxianzhuang relief river to Huanghuadian; an 800-zhang diversion ditch was opened to lead the current back to the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year the west bank at Lugou Bridge overflowed and the north head section was breached; water spread from Qiangguanying in Liangxiang through the Qiuxianzhuang relief channel to Huanghuadian; an eight-hundred-zhang diversion ditch was then cut to lead the current back into the main river.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，決北二工堤，溜注求賢村引河，至永定河下游入海。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year the north second-section dike broke; the current poured into Qiuxianzhuang diversion and reached the sea via the Yongding lower course.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year the north second-section dike burst; the current poured into the Qiuxianzhuang diversion and reached the sea by way of the lower Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 旋即斷流，又漫南頭工堤，水由老君堂、庄馬頭入大清河，凡築南堤百餘丈。

translations.literal: Soon after it cut off; then the south head-section dike overflowed; water entered the Daqing River via Laojuntang and Zhuangmatou; in all more than 100 zhang of south dike was built.
translations.idiomatic: The flow soon cut off again; then the south head-section dike overflowed; water entered the Daqing River through Laojuntang and Zhuangmatou; in all more than one hundred zhang of south dike were built.

sentences.zh: 又於玉皇廟前築挑水壩。

translations.literal: A deflection dam was also built before Yuhuang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: A deflection dam was also built in front of Yuhuang Temple.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年，決盧溝橋東西岸石堤四、土堤十八，命侍郎那彥寶、高杞分駐堵築，並疏濬下游，集民夫五萬餘治之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiaqing four stone sections and eighteen earth sections of the Lugou Bridge east and west banks broke; Vice Ministers Nayinbao and Gao Qi were ordered to station separately to block and build, dredge the lower course, and gather more than 50,000 laborers to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiaqing four stone sections and eighteen earth sections of the Lugou Bridge banks on east and west gave way; Vice Ministers Nayinbao and Gao Qi were ordered to take separate posts to close the breaches and rebuild, dredge the lower reach, and mobilize more than fifty thousand laborers for the work.

sentences.zh: 御制河決嘆，頒示群臣。

translations.literal: The emperor composed "Lament on the River Breach" and issued it to the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed the "Lament on the River Breach" and circulated it among his ministers.

sentences.zh: 兩月餘工竣。

translations.literal: Work was completed in a little over two months.
translations.idiomatic: The work was finished in a little over two months.

sentences.zh: 十五年，永定河兩岸同時漫口，直督溫承惠駐工堵合之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year both banks of the Yongding River overflowed together; Zhili Governor Wen Chenghui remained on site to block and close them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year both banks of the Yongding River overflowed at once; Zhili Governor Wen Chenghui stayed on the works to seal the breaches.

sentences.zh: 十七年，河勢北趨，葛漁城淤塞，水由黃花店下注。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the river trended north; Geyucheng silted shut; water ran down via Huanghuadian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the river turned northward; Geyucheng silted up; water discharged through Huanghuadian.

sentences.zh: 乃於舊淤河內挑挖引河，並於上游築草壩，挑溜東行，另建圈堤以防泛衍。

translations.literal: A diversion was then excavated within the old silted channel; grass dams were built upstream; the current was directed east; and an encircling dike was built separately against spreading flood.
translations.idiomatic: A diversion channel was cut within the old silted bed; grass overflow dams were built upstream; the current was turned east; and a ring dike was added to guard against widespread flooding.

sentences.zh: 二十年，拆鳳河東堤民埝以去下壅。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year civilian embankments on the Feng River's east dike were dismantled to remove downstream blockage.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year civilian embankments along the east dike of the Feng River were removed to clear downstream obstruction.

sentences.zh: 六月大雨，北岸七工漫塌，開引河，由舊河身稍南，直至黃花店，東抵西洲，長五千六百九丈。

translations.literal: In the sixth month heavy rain caused the north bank's seventh section to overflow and collapse; a diversion was opened slightly south of the old channel to Huanghuadian, east to Xizhou, 5,690 zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month heavy rains caused the seventh section on the north bank to overflow and collapse; a diversion was cut slightly south of the old bed as far as Huanghuadian and east to Xizhou, 5,690 zhang in length.

sentences.zh: 九月，水復故道。

translations.literal: In the ninth month water returned to the old course.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the water returned to the old course.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，北岸二工漫溢，頭工繼溢，側注口門三百餘丈，大興、宛平所屬各村被淹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the north bank's second section overflowed and the head section followed; water poured in at the mouth for more than 300 zhang; villages under Daxing and Wanping were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the second section on the north bank overflowed and the head section soon after; water poured through the mouth for more than three hundred zhang; villages in Daxing and Wanping were flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月塞決口，並重濬北上引河。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the breach was closed and the northbound diversion was dredged again.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the breach was sealed and the northern diversion channel was dredged anew.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，河由南八工堤盡處決而南，直趨汪兒淀。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang the river broke south at the end of the south eighth-section dike and ran straight to Wang'er Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daoguang the river burst south at the end of the south eighth-section dike and ran directly toward Wang'er Marsh.

sentences.zh: 四年，侍郎程含章勘議濬復，未果。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Vice Minister Cheng Hanzhang surveyed and proposed dredging to restore the course, but it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Vice Minister Cheng Hanzhang inspected the river and proposed dredging to restore the old course, but the plan was not implemented.

sentences.zh: 十年，直督那彥成請於大范甕口挑引河，並將新堤南遙埝加高培厚。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Zhili Governor Nayancheng asked to excavate a diversion at Dafanweng Kou and raise and thicken the distant embankment south of the new dike.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Zhili Governor Nayancheng asked to cut a diversion channel at Dafanweng Kou and to raise and thicken the distant embankment south of the new dike.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，河溜改向東北，逕竇淀，歷六道口，注大清河，汪兒淀口始塞，水由范甕口新槽復歸王慶坨故道。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year the current turned northeast, ran through Dou Marsh and Liudaokou into the Daqing River; Wang'er Marsh mouth was then blocked, and water via Fanweng Kou's new channel returned to Wangqingtuo's old course.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year the current shifted northeast, passed through Dou Marsh and Liudaokou into the Daqing River; the Wang'er Marsh outlet was then sealed, and water through the new channel at Fanweng Kou returned to the old course at Wangqingtuo.

sentences.zh: 十四年，宛平界北中、北下汛決口，水由龐各庄循舊減河至武清之黃花店，仍歸正河尾閭入海。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year breaches opened in Wanping at the north middle and north lower flood sections; water via Panggezhuang followed the old relief river to Huanghuadian in Wuqing and still returned through the main river's lower mouth to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year breaches opened in Wanping at the north middle and north lower flood sections; water from Panggezhuang followed the old relief channel to Huanghuadian in Wuqing and still reentered the sea through the main river's lower outlet.

sentences.zh: 良鄉界南二工決口，水由金門閘減河入清河，經白溝河歸大清河。

translations.literal: In Liangxiang the south second-section breach opened; water via Jinmen Sluice relief river entered the Qing River and through the Baigou River returned to the Daqing River.
translations.idiomatic: On the Liangxiang border the south second section burst; water entered the Qing River through the Jinmen Sluice relief channel and returned to the Daqing River by way of the Baigou River.

sentences.zh: 爰挑引河，自漫口迤下至單家溝，間段修築二萬七千四百餘丈。

translations.literal: A diversion was then excavated from the overflow mouth down to Danjiagou, with sectional repairs totaling more than 27,400 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: A diversion channel was then cut from the overflow point down to Danjiagou, with sectional construction totaling more than 27,400 zhang.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，南七工漫口，就迤北三里許之河西營為河頭，挑引河七十餘里，直達鳳河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the south seventh section overflowed; Hexiying about three li north was made the river head; a diversion more than seventy li long was excavated straight to the Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the south seventh section overflowed; Hexiying, about three li to the north, was made the new river head; a diversion more than seventy li long was cut straight to the Feng River.

sentences.zh: 三十年五月，上游山水下注，河驟漲，北七工漫三十餘丈，由舊減河逕母豬泊注鳳河。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year mountain floods poured down from upstream; the river rose sharply; the north seventh section overflowed for more than thirty zhang; water via the old relief river ran through Muzhubo into the Feng River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year mountain runoff poured in from upstream and the river rose abruptly; the north seventh section overflowed for more than thirty zhang; water ran through Muzhubo into the Feng River by way of the old relief channel.

sentences.zh: 勘於馮家場北河灣開引河，十月竣工。

translations.literal: On survey a diversion was opened at the north bend of the river at Fengjiachang; work was completed in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: After inspection a diversion was cut at the north bend of the river at Fengjiachang; the project was completed in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 咸豐間，南北堤潰決四次。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng era north and south dikes burst four times.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng reign the north and south dikes burst four times.

sentences.zh: 時軍務方棘，工費減發，補苴罅漏而已。

translations.literal: Military affairs were then pressing; project funds were cut; only patching gaps was possible.
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs were then urgent; project funds were reduced; repairs could do no more than patch the worst gaps.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，因河日北徙，去路淤淺，於柳坨築壩，堵截北流，引歸舊河，展寬挑深張坨、胡家房河身，經東安、武清、天津入海。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, as the river daily shifted north and its outlet silted shallow, a dam was built at Liutuo to block northward flow and lead water back to the old river; the channels at Zhangtuo and Hujiafang were widened and deepened, and water reached the sea via Dong'an, Wuqing, and Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi, because the river was shifting steadily northward and its outlet had silted up, a dam was built at Liutuo to cut off the northward flow and return the water to the old course; the beds at Zhangtuo and Hujiafang were widened and deepened, and the river again reached the sea through Dong'an, Wuqing, and Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 六年以後，時有潰決。

translations.literal: After the sixth year breaches occurred from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: After the sixth year breaches continued to occur from time to time.

sentences.zh: 八年，直督曾國籓請於南七工築截水大壩，兩旁修築圈埝，並挑濬中洪，疏通下口，以免壅潰。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Zhili Governor Zeng Guofan asked to build a major intercepting dam at the south seventh section, ring embankments on both sides, and excavate and dredge the central channel and clear the lower outlet to avoid blockage and breach.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Zhili Governor Zeng Guofan proposed building a major intercepting dam at the south seventh section, ring embankments on both flanks, and dredging the central channel while clearing the lower outlet to prevent backup and collapse.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，南岸石堤漫口，奪溜逕良鄉、涿州注大清河入海。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the south bank stone dike overflowed; the current seized through Liangxiang and Zhuo and entered the Daqing River to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the stone dike on the south bank overflowed; the main current was diverted through Liangxiang and Zhuo into the Daqing River and on to the sea.

sentences.zh: 明年，允直督李鴻章請，修金門閘壩，疏濬引河，由童村入小清河。

translations.literal: The next year Zhili Governor Li Hongzhang's request was granted to repair the Jinmen Sluice dam, dredge the diversion, and lead water from Tongcun into the Xiaoqing River.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Li Hongzhang's request as Zhili governor was approved: the Jinmen Sluice dam was repaired, the diversion channel dredged, and water led from Tongcun into the Xiaoqing River.

sentences.zh: 石堤決口塞。

translations.literal: The stone dike breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The breach in the stone dike was sealed.

sentences.zh: 十二年，南四工漫口，由霸州檿牛河東流。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the south fourth section overflowed; water ran east via Bazhou's Zhenniu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the south fourth section overflowed; water ran east through the Zhenniu River in Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 爰將引河增長，復築挑水壩一。

translations.literal: The diversion was then lengthened and one deflection dam was built again.
translations.idiomatic: The diversion channel was lengthened and another deflection dam was built.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，南二汛漫口，隨塞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu the south second flood section overflowed and was promptly closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu the south second flood section overflowed and was sealed at once.

sentences.zh: 四年，北六汛決口，築合後，復於坦坡埝尾接築民埝至青光以下。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the north sixth flood section breached; after closing, civilian embankments were continued from Tanpo embankment's end to below Qingguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the north sixth flood section burst; after the breach was closed, civilian embankments were extended from the end of the Tanpo embankment down to below Qingguang.

sentences.zh: 十年，以鳳河當永定河之沖，年久淤墊，以工代賑，起南苑五空閘，訖武清緱上村，間段挑濬，並培築堤壩決口。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, as the Feng River lay in the Yongding's direct thrust and had silted for years, relief work replaced famine relief; from Nanyuan's Wukong Sluice to Goushang village in Wuqing sectional dredging was done and dike and dam breaches raised and closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, because the Feng River bore the full force of the Yongding and had silted up over many years, public works were used for famine relief; from Wukong Sluice in Nanyuan to Goushang village in Wuqing the channel was dredged in sections, and breaches in dikes and dams were raised and sealed.

sentences.zh: 十六年，大水，畿輔各河並漲，永定北上汛、南三汛同時漫決。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year great floods raised all rivers in the capital region together; the Yongding's north upper flood section and south third flood section overflowed and broke at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year catastrophic floods raised every river in the capital region at once; the north upper and south third flood sections of the Yongding overflowed and burst together.

sentences.zh: 命直督迅籌堵築，添修挑壩岸堤，又疏引河六十餘里。

translations.literal: The Zhili governor was ordered swiftly to plan blocking and building, add deflection dams and bank dikes, and dredge a diversion of more than sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhili governor was ordered to plan blocking and rebuilding at once, add deflection dams and bank dikes, and dredge a diversion channel more than sixty li long.

sentences.zh: 十八年夏，大雨，河水陡漲，南上汛灰壩漫口四十餘丈。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighteenth year heavy rain made the river rise sharply; the south upper flood section's lime dam overflowed for more than forty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eighteenth year heavy rains sent the river up abruptly; the lime dam in the south upper flood section overflowed for more than forty zhang.

sentences.zh: 給事中洪良品言北岸頭工關係最重，請接連石景山以下添砌石堤，以資捍衛。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Hong Liangpin said the north bank head section was most critical and asked to add stone dikes continuously below Shijingshan for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Hong Liangpin reported that the north bank head section was the most critical point and asked that stone dikes be added continuously below Shijingshan for protection.

sentences.zh: 下所司籌議。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the responsible offices for planning.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the responsible offices for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 因工艱費鉅，擇要接築石堤八里，並添修石格。

translations.literal: Because the work was difficult and costs vast, eight li of stone dike were built at key points and stone grids were added.
translations.idiomatic: Because the work was arduous and the cost enormous, eight li of stone dike were built at the most critical points and stone grids were added.

sentences.zh: 十九年冬，因頻年潰決為患，命河督許振禕偕直督會勘籌辦。

translations.literal: In the winter of the nineteenth year, because repeated breaches had caused harm for years, River Director Xu Zhenyi was ordered with the Zhili governor jointly to survey and plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the nineteenth year, because repeated breaches had plagued the river for years, River Director Xu Zhenyi was ordered to inspect the works jointly with the Zhili governor and draw up a plan.

sentences.zh: 振禕陳疏下游、保近險、濬中洪、建減壩、治上游五事。

translations.literal: Zhenyi memorialized five measures: clear the lower course, protect nearby danger points, dredge the central channel, build relief dams, and manage the upper reach.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyi proposed five measures: regulate the lower course, secure the nearest danger points, dredge the central channel, build relief dams, and manage the upper reach.

sentences.zh: 直隸按察使周馥並建議於盧溝南岸築減水大石壩，以水抵涵洞上楣為準，逾則瀉去。

translations.literal: Zhili Judicial Commissioner Zhou Fu also proposed building a major stone flood-relief dam on the south bank at Lugou, using water reaching the culvert lintel as the mark—beyond that it would be discharged.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili Judicial Commissioner Zhou Fu also proposed building a major stone flood-relief dam on the south bank at Lugou, set so that when the water reached the lintel of the culvert it would be discharged.

sentences.zh: 詔如所請。

translations.literal: An edict approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the proposals.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，北六工、北中汛先後漫溢，由韓家樹匯大清河，遂挑濬大清河積淤二十餘里。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the north sixth section and north middle flood section overflowed in succession; water gathered at Hanjiashu into the Daqing River; the Daqing's accumulated silt for more than twenty li was then dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the north sixth section and the north middle flood section overflowed in turn; water collected at Hanjiashu into the Daqing River; more than twenty li of accumulated silt in the Daqing were then dredged.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，詔直督裕祿詳勘全河形勢，以紓水患。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year an edict ordered Zhili Governor Yulu to survey the whole river's configuration in detail to ease flood harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year an edict ordered Zhili Governor Yulu to survey the entire river in detail so as to relieve flood damage.

sentences.zh: 裕祿言：「畿輔緯川百道，總匯於南北運、大清、永定、子牙五經河，由海河達海，惟永定水渾善淤，變遷無定。

translations.literal: Yulu said: "In the capital region a hundred streams run latitudinally, all gathering in the five trunk rivers—the North and South Canal, Daqing, Yongding, and Ziya—and reaching the sea via the Hai River; only the Yongding's water is muddy and prone to silt, shifting without fixed course.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu reported: "In the capital region hundreds of streams cross the plain, all converging on the five trunk rivers—the North and South Canal, Daqing, Yongding, and Ziya—and reaching the sea through the Hai River; only the Yongding runs muddy, silts easily, and shifts without a fixed course.

sentences.zh: 從前下口遙堤寬四十餘里，分南、北、中三洪。

translations.literal: Formerly the lower outlet's distant dike was more than forty li wide, divided into south, north, and central channels.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the distant dike at the lower outlet was more than forty li wide and divided the flow into south, north, and central channels.

sentences.zh: 嗣因南、中兩洪淤墊，全由北洪穿鳳入運。」

translations.literal: Later, as the south and central channels silted, the whole flow passed through the north channel via Feng into the Canal."
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the south and central channels silted up, the entire current passed through the north channel via the Feng River into the Canal."

sentences.zh: 因陳統籌疏築之策七：一，先治海河，俾暢尾閭，然後施工上游；

translations.literal: He then set forth seven coordinated dredging and building measures: first, treat the Hai River so the lower mouth runs clear, then work upstream;
translations.idiomatic: He then proposed seven coordinated measures for dredging and construction: first, regulate the Hai River so the lower outlet runs freely, then work upstream;

sentences.zh: 一，宜以鳳河東堤外大窪為永定下口；

translations.literal: second, the great depression east of the Feng River's east dike should serve as the Yongding's lower outlet;
translations.idiomatic: second, the great depression east of the Feng River's east dike should be made the Yongding's lower outlet;

sentences.zh: 一，修筑北運河西堤；

translations.literal: third, build the North Canal's west dike;
translations.idiomatic: third, build the west dike of the North Canal;

sentences.zh: 一，規復大清河下口故道於西沽；

translations.literal: fourth, plan to restore the Daqing River's old lower course at Xigu;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, plan to restore the Daqing River's old lower course at Xigu;

sentences.zh: 一，修築格淀；

translations.literal: fifth, build and repair Gedian Marsh;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, build and repair the Gedian embankment;

sentences.zh: 一，修築韓家樹橫直各堤；

translations.literal: sixth, build the cross and longitudinal dikes at Hanjiashu;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, build the transverse and longitudinal dikes at Hanjiashu;

sentences.zh: 一，疏濬中亭河，以期一勞永逸。

translations.literal: seventh, dredge the Zhongting River, hoping for a single effort lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: seventh, dredge the Zhongting River in the hope of a lasting remedy.

sentences.zh: 需費七十七萬有奇。

translations.literal: The cost would be a little over 770,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: The project would require a little over 770,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 帝命分年籌辦。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered it planned over successive years.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the work to be planned and carried out over successive years.

sentences.zh: 適有拳匪之亂，不果行。

translations.literal: Just then the Boxer turmoil arose and it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Boxer uprising intervened, and the plan was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 三十年後，南北岸屢見潰決，均隨時堵合。

translations.literal: After thirty years breaches were seen repeatedly on north and south banks, all closed promptly as they occurred.
translations.idiomatic: In the decades that followed, breaches opened repeatedly on both banks, and each was sealed as soon as it appeared.

sentences.zh: 論者以為若將險工全作石堤，灣狹處改從寬直，並於南七工放水東行，傍淀達津，再加以石壩分泄盛漲，庶幾永保安瀾雲。

translations.literal: Commentators held that if all danger works were made stone dikes, narrow bends widened and straightened, water released east from the south seventh section beside marshes to Tianjin, and stone dams added to divide peak floods, perhaps lasting peace and safety could be secured.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators argued that if every danger point were faced with stone dikes, narrow bends were widened and straightened, water were released eastward from the south seventh section along the marshes to Tianjin, and stone overflow dams were added to divide peak floods, the river might at last be kept permanently secure.

sentences.zh: 海塘惟江、浙有之。

translations.literal: Sea dikes exist only in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Sea dikes exist only in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 于海濱衛以塘，所以捍禦咸潮，奠民居而便耕稼也。

translations.literal: On the seashore dikes are maintained to repel salt tides, settle dwellings, and ease farming.
translations.idiomatic: Along the coast dikes are maintained to hold back the salt tide, secure settlements, and protect the fields.

sentences.zh: 在江南者，自松江之金山至寶山，長三萬六千四百餘丈。

translations.literal: In Jiangnan, from Jinshan in Songjiang to Baoshan, the length is more than 36,400 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangnan the dikes run from Jinshan in Songjiang to Baoshan, more than 36,400 zhang in length.

sentences.zh: 在浙江者，自仁和之烏龍廟至江南金山界，長三萬七千二百餘丈。

translations.literal: In Zhejiang, from Wulong Temple in Renhe to the Jinshan border with Jiangnan, the length is more than 37,200 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhejiang they run from Wulong Temple in Renhe to the Jinshan border with Jiangnan, more than 37,200 zhang in length.

sentences.zh: 江南地方平洋暗潮，水勢尚緩。

translations.literal: Jiangnan's terrain is level; tides are hidden; the water force is still moderate.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's coast is level and its tides comparatively mild; the force of the water is still moderate.

sentences.zh: 浙則江水順流而下，海潮逆江而上，其衝突激涌，勢尤猛險。

translations.literal: In Zhejiang the river runs down while sea tide runs up against it; their clash surges fiercely, the force especially violent and dangerous.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhejiang the river runs downstream while the sea tide runs up against it; where they meet the surge is fierce and the danger especially great.

sentences.zh: 唐、宋以來，屢有修建，其制未備。

translations.literal: Since Tang and Song there have been repeated constructions, but the system was not complete.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tang and Song the dikes had been rebuilt many times, but the system was never fully established.

sentences.zh: 清代易土塘為石塘，更民修為官修，鉅工累作，力求鞏固，濱海生靈，始獲樂利矣。

translations.literal: In the Qing earth dikes were changed to stone dikes, private maintenance to official maintenance; great works were done repeatedly, striving for solidity, and coastal people at last obtained ease and benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qing earth dikes were replaced with stone dikes and private upkeep with official maintenance; great projects were undertaken again and again in pursuit of strength, and the coastal population at last enjoyed security and prosperity.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，禮科給事中張惟赤言：「江、浙二省，杭、嘉、湖、寧、紹、蘇、松七郡皆濱海，賴有塘以捍其外，至海鹽兩山夾峙，潮勢尤猛。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Supervising Secretary Zhang Weichi of the Rites Section said: "In Jiangsu and Zhejiang the seven prefectures Hang, Jia, Hu, Ning, Shao, Su, and Song all border the sea and rely on dikes to defend them; at Haiyan two mountains flank each other and the tide is especially fierce.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Supervising Secretary Zhang Weichi of the Rites Section reported: "In Jiangsu and Zhejiang the seven prefectures of Hang, Jia, Hu, Ning, Shao, Su, and Song all lie on the coast and depend on sea dikes for protection; at Haiyan, where two mountains face each other, the tide is especially violent.

sentences.zh: 故明代特編海塘夫銀，以事歲修。
