translations.literal: Therefore the Ming specially allocated sea-dike labor silver for annual repair.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason the Ming specially set aside funds for sea-dike labor to support annual repairs.

sentences.zh: 近此款不知銷歸何地，塘基盡圮。

translations.literal: Recently this fund's disbursement is unknown and the dike foundations are wholly ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Recently it is unclear where this fund has gone, and the dike foundations have collapsed entirely.

sentences.zh: 儻風濤大作，徑從坍口深入，恐為害七郡匪淺。

translations.literal: If wind and waves rise greatly and enter directly through collapsed openings, harm to the seven prefectures may be no small matter.
translations.idiomatic: If wind and waves rise and water pours straight through the collapsed sections, the seven prefectures may suffer no small harm.

sentences.zh: 請嚴飭撫、按勒限報竣，仍定限歲修，以防患未然。」

translations.literal: I ask that governors and surveillance commissioners be strictly ordered to complete within deadlines and that annual repair deadlines still be fixed to guard against harm before it arises."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the governors and surveillance commissioners be strictly ordered to finish repairs within a fixed deadline and that annual maintenance be required again, so harm may be prevented before it arises."

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，浙江海寧海溢，潰塘二千三百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, the sea overflowed at Haining in Zhejiang, and more than twenty-three hundred zhang of dike were breached.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Kangxi reign, the sea surged over Haining in Zhejiang and breached more than twenty-three hundred zhang of tidal dike.

sentences.zh: 總督趙廷臣、巡撫硃昌祚請發帑修築，並修尖山石堤五千餘丈。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhao Tingchen and Provincial Governor Zhu Changzuo requested disbursement from the treasury for repairs, and also to repair more than five thousand zhang of stone embankment at Jianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhao Tingchen and Provincial Governor Zhu Changzuo asked that treasury funds be released for repairs, and that more than five thousand zhang of stone embankment at Jianshan be restored as well.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，修海鹽石塘千丈。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, one thousand zhang of stone dike at Haiyan was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, one thousand zhang of stone tidal dike at Haiyan were repaired.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，颶風大作，海潮越堤入，衝決海寧塘千六百餘丈，海鹽塘三百餘丈，築之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year a great hurricane blew; the sea tide crossed the dike and entered, breaching more than sixteen hundred zhang of Haining dike and more than three hundred zhang of Haiyan dike; they were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year a violent hurricane drove the tide over the dikes, tearing out more than sixteen hundred zhang at Haining and more than three hundred at Haiyan; the breaches were then rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，巡撫硃軾請修海寧石塘，下用木櫃，外築坦水，再開濬備塘河以防泛溢。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year Provincial Governor Zhu Shi requested repair of the Haining stone dike, using wooden cribs below, building sloped revetment outside, and again dredging the reserve dike canal to guard against overflow.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year Provincial Governor Zhu Shi proposed rebuilding the Haining stone dike with wooden cribs below, sloped revetment on the seaward face, and renewed dredging of the backup canal to contain flooding.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，總督滿保及軾疏言：「上虞夏蓋山迤西沿海土塘沖坍無存，其南大亹沙淤成陸，江水海潮直衝北大亹而東，並海寧老鹽倉皆坍沒。」

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year Governor-General Manbao and Zhu memorialized: "West of Shangyu's Mount Xiayu along the coast, the earthen dikes were washed away without remainder; south of it the sands of Da Wai silted into dry land, and river water and sea tide struck straight at Bei Dai and ran east, while Haining's Old Salt Storehouse and all else were washed away."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year Governor-General Manbao and Zhu Shi reported: "Along the coast west of Mount Xiayu in Shangyu, the earthen dikes had been scoured away entirely. South of there the sands of Da Wai had accreted into dry land, so river and tide now drove straight at Bei Dai and eastward, and the Old Salt Storehouse at Haining, among other sites, had collapsed into the sea."

sentences.zh: 因陳辦法五：一，築老鹽倉北岸石塘千三百餘丈，保護杭、嘉、湖三府民田水利；

translations.literal: Thereupon they set forth five measures: first, build more than thirteen hundred zhang of stone dike on the north bank at Old Salt Storehouse to protect the fields and waterworks of the three prefectures Hang, Jia, and Hu;
translations.idiomatic: They proposed five remedies: first, build more than thirteen hundred zhang of stone dike along the north bank at Old Salt Storehouse to safeguard cropland and irrigation in Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou prefectures;

sentences.zh: 一，築新式石塘，使之穩固；

translations.literal: second, build new-style stone dikes to make them secure;
translations.idiomatic: second, construct new-style stone dikes built to endure;

sentences.zh: 一，開中小亹淤沙，使江海盡歸赭山、河庄山中間故道，可免潮勢北沖；

translations.literal: third, open the silted sands of Zhong Xiao Wai so that river and sea all return to the old channel between Mount Zhe and Mount Hezhuang, which can avert the tide's northward thrust;
translations.idiomatic: third, cut through the shoals at Zhong Xiao Wai so the river and sea resume their old course between Mount Zhe and Mount Hezhuang, deflecting the tide's northward push;

sentences.zh: 一，築夏蓋山石塘千七百餘丈，以御南岸潮患；

translations.literal: fourth, build more than seventeen hundred zhang of stone dike at Mount Xiayu to repel tidal harm on the south bank;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, raise more than seventeen hundred zhang of stone dike at Mount Xiayu to shield the south bank from tidal damage;

sentences.zh: 一，專員歲修，以保永固。

translations.literal: fifth, appoint dedicated officers for annual repair to secure lasting solidity.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, assign officers to maintain the works yearly so they would stand firm for the long term.

sentences.zh: 下部議，如所請行。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and carried out the request as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The Board deliberated and approved the plan as requested.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，帝以塘工緊要，命吏部尚書硃軾會同浙撫法海、蘇撫何天培勘估杭、嘉、湖等府塘工，需銀十萬五千兩有奇，松江府華、婁、上海等縣塘工，需銀十九萬兩有奇，部議允之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, considering the dike works urgent, the Emperor ordered Minister of Personnel Zhu Shi, together with Zhejiang Governor Fa Hai and Jiangsu Governor He Tianpei, to survey and estimate the dike works of Hang, Jia, Hu, and other prefectures, requiring a little more than 105,000 taels of silver; the dike works of Hua, Lou, Shanghai, and other counties in Songjiang Prefecture required a little more than 190,000 taels; the ministry approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng the Emperor, deeming the tidal works critical, ordered Minister of Personnel Zhu Shi to join Zhejiang Governor Fa Hai and Jiangsu Governor He Tianpei in surveying the dikes of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and neighboring prefectures, which would cost somewhat more than 105,000 taels, and the dikes of Huating, Lou, Shanghai, and other counties in Songjiang, which would need somewhat more than 190,000 taels; the Board approved.

sentences.zh: 六年，巡撫李衛請將驟決不可緩待之工，先行搶修，隨後奏聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Provincial Governor Li Wei requested that works suddenly breached and not to be delayed be first given emergency repair, with memorial to follow.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Provincial Governor Li Wei asked permission to undertake emergency repairs wherever sudden breaches could not wait, and to report afterward.

sentences.zh: 「搶修」之名自此始。

translations.literal: The name "emergency repair" began from this.
translations.idiomatic: From this point the term "emergency repair" entered official use.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命內大臣海望、直督李衛赴浙查勘海塘，諭曰：「如果工程永固，可保民生，即費帑千萬不必惜。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he ordered Inner Court Minister Haiwang and Zhili Governor-General Li Wei to go to Zhejiang to inspect the sea dikes, instructing: "If the works can be made permanently secure and the people's livelihood preserved, even ten million from the treasury should not be spared."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he dispatched Inner Court Minister Haiwang and Zhili Governor-General Li Wei to Zhejiang to inspect the sea dikes, saying: "If the works can be made lasting and the people protected, spend ten million taels from the treasury without hesitation."

sentences.zh: 尋請於尖、塔兩山間建石壩堵水，並改建草塘及條石塊石各塘為大石塘，更於舊塘內添築上備塘。

translations.literal: Shortly after they requested building a stone dam between Jian and Ta mountains to block the water, and also converting grass dikes and strip-stone and block-stone dikes into great stone dikes, and further adding upper reserve dikes within the old dikes.
translations.idiomatic: They soon proposed a stone dam between Jian and Ta mountains to hold back the current, conversion of grass dikes and mixed strip- and block-stone works into great stone dikes, and construction of upper backup dikes behind the existing line.

sentences.zh: 十二年，因堵尖山水口、開中小亹引河久未施工，責浙督程元章等督辦不力，命杭州副都統隆升總理，御史偏武佐之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, because blocking the Jianshan water mouth and opening the Zhong Xiao Wai diversion had long gone unexecuted, Zhejiang Governor Cheng Yuanzhang and others were blamed for lax supervision; Long Sheng, deputy lieutenant-general at Hangzhou, was ordered to take overall charge, with Censor Pian Wu assisting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, because the Jianshan closure and the Zhong Xiao Wai diversion had long remained unfinished, Zhejiang Governor Cheng Yuanzhang and his colleagues were censured for poor oversight; Deputy Lieutenant-General Long Sheng of Hangzhou was placed in overall charge, assisted by Censor Pian Wu.

sentences.zh: 五月工竣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work was finished in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命南河督嵇曾筠總理塘工。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he ordered Southern Rivers Director-General Ji Zengyun to take overall charge of the dike works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he appointed Southern Rivers Director-General Ji Zengyun to oversee the tidal works.

sentences.zh: 曾筠言：「海寧南門外俯臨江海，請先築魚鱗石塘五百餘丈，保衛城池。」

translations.literal: Ji Zengyun said: "Outside Haining's south gate one looks down on river and sea; please first build more than five hundred zhang of scale-pattern stone dike to protect the city."
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zengyun reported: "Outside Haining's south gate the land overlooks river and sea; please first build more than five hundred zhang of scale-pattern stone dike there to protect the city."

sentences.zh: 下廷臣議行。

translations.literal: It was sent down for court ministers to deliberate and carry out.
translations.idiomatic: The court was ordered to deliberate and implement the plan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，署蘇撫顧琮請設海防道，專司海塘歲修事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, acting Jiangsu Governor Gu Cong requested establishment of a Coastal Defense Circuit to specialize in annual repair of the sea dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong, acting Jiangsu Governor Gu Cong proposed a Coastal Defense Circuit devoted solely to the yearly upkeep of the sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 曾筠請於仁、寧等處酌建魚鱗大石塘六千餘丈，均從之。

translations.literal: Ji Zengyun requested building as appropriate more than six thousand zhang of scale-pattern great stone dike at Renhe, Haining, and other places; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zengyun asked to build more than six thousand zhang of scale-pattern great stone dike at Renhe, Haining, and elsewhere as conditions required; all was approved.

sentences.zh: 明年，建海寧浦兒兜至尖山頭魚鱗大石塘五千九百餘丈。

translations.literal: The next year, more than five thousand nine hundred zhang of scale-pattern great stone dike was built from Haining's Pu'erdou to Jianshantou.
translations.idiomatic: The following year more than five thousand nine hundred zhang of scale-pattern great stone dike were raised from Pu'erdou in Haining to Jianshantou.

sentences.zh: 四年，允浙撫盧焯請，築尖山大壩，次年秋工竣，御制文記之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhejiang Governor Lu Chao's request was granted to build the great Jianshan dam; the next autumn the works were completed, and the Emperor composed an inscription to record it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the court approved Zhejiang Governor Lu Chao's plan for the great Jianshan dam; work finished the following autumn, and the Emperor wrote an inscription to commemorate it.

sentences.zh: 六年，左都御史劉統勛言：「前據閩浙總督德沛請改老鹽倉至章家菴柴塘為石塘，廷議准行。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Left Censor-in-Chief Liu Tongxun said: "Earlier, according to Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General De Pei's request to convert the fascine dike from Old Salt Storehouse to Zhangjia'an into stone dike, the court deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Left Censor-in-Chief Liu Tongxun wrote: "Earlier the court had approved Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General De Pei's plan to replace the fascine dike from Old Salt Storehouse to Zhangjia'an with stone.

sentences.zh: 臣意以為草塘改建不必過急，南北岸塘工實不宜緩。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that converting the fascine dike need not be overly urgent, but the dike works on north and south banks truly should not be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: In my view the fascine-to-stone conversion need not be rushed, but repairs along both north and south banks cannot wait.

sentences.zh: 蓋通塘形勢，海寧之潮猶屬往來滌盪，而海鹽之潮，則對面直衝，其大石塘歲久罅漏，尤宜及早補苴。

translations.literal: For the situation along the whole dike line, Haining's tide is still of the back-and-forth scouring kind, whereas Haiyan's tide strikes straight on the face; its great stone dike, after years, has cracks and leaks, and should especially be patched early.
translations.idiomatic: Along the full line, Haining still sees tides that surge back and forth, but at Haiyan the tide meets the dike head-on; there the great stone work, cracked and leaking after years of service, most urgently needs repair.

sentences.zh: 臣以大概計之，動發七十萬金，而通塘可有苞桑之固。」

translations.literal: Your servant estimates in the rough that mobilizing seven hundred thousand in cash would give the whole dike line the solidity of wrapped mulberry."
translations.idiomatic: By my rough estimate, seven hundred thousand taels would make the entire line secure as wrapped mulberry—lasting and strong."

sentences.zh: 疏入，命統勛會同浙督德沛、浙撫常安察勘。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, Tongxun was ordered to join Zhejiang Governor-General De Pei and Zhejiang Governor Chang An in inspection.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, Liu Tongxun was ordered to inspect the works jointly with Zhejiang Governor-General De Pei and Zhejiang Governor Chang An.

sentences.zh: 尋覆稱：「改建石工，誠經久之圖，但須寬以時日，年以三百丈為率。」

translations.literal: Soon the reply stated: "Converting to stone work is truly a long-term plan, but time must be allowed generously, at a rate of three hundred zhang per year."
translations.idiomatic: Their reply held: "Stone conversion was indeed the lasting solution, but should proceed slowly—three hundred zhang a year."

sentences.zh: 七年，總督那蘇圖請先於最險處間段排築石簍，俟根腳堅實，再建石塘。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Governor-General Nasutu requested first, at the most dangerous sections by intervals, laying out stone cages; when the foundations were solid, then building stone dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Governor-General Nasutu proposed building stone cages in sections at the worst points first, then raising stone dikes once the footings had set firm.

sentences.zh: 越二年，遣尚書訥親勘視。

translations.literal: Two years later, Minister Neqin was dispatched to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Minister Neqin was sent to survey the coast.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「仁、寧二邑柴塘穩固，若慮護沙坍漲無常，第將中小亹故道開濬，俾潮水循規出入，上下塘俱可安堵。」

translations.literal: The memorial stated: "The fascine dikes in Renhe and Haining counties are secure; if one fears the protective sands' erosion and accretion are unpredictable, simply dredge open the old channel of Zhong Xiao Wai so the tide may enter and leave by rule, and the upper and lower dikes can all be at peace."
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "The fascine dikes in Renhe and Haining are sound; if shifting protective sands are the worry, dredge the old Zhong Xiao Wai channel so the tide follows its proper course—in that case both upper and lower dikes will hold."

sentences.zh: 於是改建石工之議遂寢。

translations.literal: Thereupon the proposal to convert to stone works was set aside.
translations.idiomatic: The plan to convert the dikes to stone was therefore dropped.

sentences.zh: 七月，蘇撫陳大受言：「寶山地濱大海，月浦土塘被潮沖刷，請建單石壩，外加椿石坦坡各百七十丈，並接築沙塘，使與土塘聯屬，中設涵洞宣洩。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month Jiangsu Governor Chen Dashou said: "Baoshan lies along the great sea; at Yuepu the earthen dike was scoured by tide. Please build a single-stone dam, and outside add pile-and-stone sloped revetments of one hundred seventy zhang each, and also join-build a sand dike linking with the earthen dike, with culverts in the middle for discharge."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Jiangsu Governor Chen Dashou reported: "Baoshan fronts the open sea, and at Yuepu the earthen dike is being eaten by the tide. I ask to build a single-stone dam, add one hundred seventy zhang of piled-stone slope on each side, link a sand dike to the earthwork, and set culverts through it for drainage."

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: The Board approved and ordered implementation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，常安言：「蜀山迤北有積沙四五百丈，橫亙中間。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Chang An said: "North of Shushan there is accumulated sand of four to five hundred zhang, stretching across the middle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Chang An reported: "North of Shushan a shoal four to five hundred zhang wide blocks the channel.

sentences.zh: 先就沙嘴開溝四，以引潮水攻刷。

translations.literal: First at the sand spit four channels were opened to draw the tide to attack and scour.
translations.idiomatic: Four cuts were first opened at the sand spit to draw the tide in and scour the shoal.

sentences.zh: 今伏汛已過，南沙坍卸殆盡，蜀山已在水中，潮汐漸向南趨。

translations.literal: Now the summer flood season has passed; the south sand bank has eroded almost entirely; Shushan is already in the water, and the tide is gradually tending south.
translations.idiomatic: The summer flood has passed, the southern shoal has largely washed away, Shushan stands in open water, and the tide is shifting southward.

sentences.zh: 倘秋汛不復涌沙，則大溜竟行中小亹矣。」

translations.literal: If the autumn flood does not again throw up sand, then the main current will run entirely through Zhong Xiao Wai."
translations.idiomatic: If the autumn tides do not rebuild the shoal, the main current will flow through Zhong Xiao Wai for good."

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: The report was noted.
translations.idiomatic: The court took note.

sentences.zh: 十二年，常安委員疏濬蜀山一帶，用切沙法疏刷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Chang An commissioned officers to dredge the Shushan area, using the sand-cutting method to scour.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Chang An sent officers to dredge around Shushan by cutting through the shoals.

sentences.zh: 十一月朔，中小亹引河一夕沖開，大溜經由故道，南北岸水遠沙長，皆成坦途。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month the Zhong Xiao Wai diversion was breached open in one night; the main current passed through the old channel, and on north and south banks water receded and sand extended—all became level ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month the Zhong Xiao Wai diversion broke open overnight; the main current returned to its old course, water drew back on both banks as sand built up, and the ground lay level on either side.

sentences.zh: 十三年，大學士高斌、訥親先後奉命查勘塘工。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Grand Secretaries Gao Bin and Neqin were in succession ordered to inspect the dike works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Grand Secretaries Gao Bin and Neqin were sent in turn to inspect the tidal works.

sentences.zh: 斌請於東西柴石各塘後身加築土堰，攩護潮頭。

translations.literal: Bin requested adding earthen weirs behind the east and west fascine-and-stone dikes to block and shield the tide head.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin proposed earthen weirs behind the fascine-and-stone dikes east and west to break the force of the tide.

sentences.zh: 四月，訥親疏陳善後事宜，命巡撫方觀承酌議。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Neqin memorialized on follow-up measures; Provincial Governor Fang Guancheng was ordered to deliberate as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Neqin laid out plans for follow-up work, and Provincial Governor Fang Guancheng was told to decide the details.

sentences.zh: 觀承請於北塘北大亹故道，及三里橋、掇轉廟等處，設竹簍滾壩，堵御潮溝，大小山圩改建塊石塘，南塘各工，預籌防護，並將右營員弁兵丁調派，分汛防駐。

translations.literal: Guancheng requested at the north dike's Bei Dai old channel and at Sanli Bridge, Duozhuan Temple, and other places setting bamboo-cage rolling dams to block tidal gullies; converting the dikes at Da Xiao Shanwei to block-stone dikes; for all south dike works, preparing protection in advance; and also deploying officers, soldiers, and men of the Right Battalion in divided garrisons for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guancheng asked for bamboo-cage rolling dams along the north dike's old Bei Dai channel and at Sanli Bridge, Duozhuan Temple, and similar points to seal tidal cuts; block-stone dikes at Da and Xiao Shanwei; advance safeguards on the south bank; and detachments from the Right Battalion posted at divided stations along the line.

sentences.zh: 下廷議允行。

translations.literal: It was sent to court deliberation and approved for execution.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated and approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，允巡撫永貴請，改建山陰宋家漊土塘為石塘，加築坦水。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Governor Yonggui's request was granted to convert the earthen dike at Songjialou in Shanyin into stone dike and add sloped revetment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the court approved Governor Yonggui's plan to rebuild the earthen dike at Songjialou in Shanyin as stone and add sloped revetment.

sentences.zh: 十七年，巡撫雅爾哈善言：「中亹山勢僅寬六里，浮沙易淤，且南岸文堂山腳有沙嘴百三十餘丈，挑溜北趨，北岸河庄山外亦有沙嘴五十餘丈，頗礙中亹大溜。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Governor Yeerhashan said: "Between the Zhong Wai mountains the width is only six li; floating sand silts easily, and moreover at the foot of Wentang Mountain on the south bank there is a sand spit of more than one hundred thirty zhang that deflects the current north, while outside Hezhuang Mountain on the north bank there is also a sand spit of more than fifty zhang that greatly obstructs the main current of Zhong Wai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Governor Yeerhashan wrote: "The channel between the Zhong Wai hills is barely six li wide and silts up quickly. A spit more than one hundred thirty zhang long at the foot of Wentang Mountain on the south bank turns the current north, and another of more than fifty zhang north of Hezhuang Mountain blocks the main flow through Zhong Wai.

sentences.zh: 現將兩處漲沙挑切疏通，俾免阻滯。」

translations.literal: Now the accreted sand at both places is being cut and dredged open to avoid obstruction."
translations.idiomatic: Work is under way to cut and dredge both shoals so the current will not be impeded."

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉勉。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor responded with praise and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 十九年，因浙省塘工無險，省海防道。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, because Zhejiang's dike works had no danger, the Coastal Defense Circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the Coastal Defense Circuit was abolished, the Zhejiang dikes being judged free of hazard.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，喀爾吉善言：「水勢南趨，北塘穩固，而險工在紹興一帶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Ka'erjishan said: "The water trend is tending south; the north dike is secure, but the dangerous works are in the Shaoxing area.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Ka'erjishan reported: "The current is shifting south; the north bank is secure, but the critical works lie around Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 擬於宋家漊、楊柳港，照海寧魚鱗大條石塘式，建四百丈。」

translations.literal: It is proposed at Songjialou and Yangliu Harbor, following the Haining scale-pattern great strip-stone dike model, to build four hundred zhang."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed four hundred zhang of Haining-style scale-pattern great strip-stone dike at Songjialou and Yangliu Harbor."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，增築鎮海縣海塘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the sea dike of Zhenhai County was extended and built.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the sea dike at Zhenhai County was extended.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，蘇撫陳宏謀言，常熟、昭文濱海地方，從太倉州境接築土塘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Jiangsu Governor Chen Hongmou stated that along the coast of Changshu and Zhaowen, earthen dike should be joined and built from the border of Taicang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Jiangsu Governor Chen Hongmou proposed linking earthen dikes along the Changshu and Zhaowen coast from the Taicang prefectural border.

sentences.zh: 嗣開白茆河、徐六涇二口，建閘啟閉。

translations.literal: Later the mouths of Baimao River and Xuliujing were opened, and sluice gates were built for opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: Later the mouths of the Baimao River and Xuliujing were opened and fitted with gates to regulate flow.

sentences.zh: 本年潮漲，石牆傾圮，請改為滾壩。

translations.literal: This year when the tide rose, the stone wall collapsed; he requested converting it to a rolling dam.
translations.idiomatic: That year a high tide brought down the stone wall; he asked to replace it with a rolling dam.

sentences.zh: 得旨允行。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript approved execution.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，帝南巡，閱海寧海塘工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the Emperor made a southern tour and inspected the Haining sea dike works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on his southern tour, the Emperor inspected the Haining sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕念海塘為越中第一保障。

translations.literal: He instructed: "I consider the sea dike the foremost safeguard of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "I regard the sea dikes as Yue's first line of defense.

sentences.zh: 比歲潮勢漸趨北大亹，實關海寧、錢塘諸邑利害。

translations.literal: In recent years the tide's force has gradually tended toward Bei Dai, which truly concerns the interests of Haining, Qiantang, and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the tide has been shifting toward Bei Dai, which directly affects Haining, Qiantang, and the neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 計改老鹽倉一帶柴塘為石，而議者紛歧。

translations.literal: The plan was to convert the fascine dike along Old Salt Storehouse to stone, but those who deliberated were divided.
translations.idiomatic: There had been plans to replace the fascine dike at Old Salt Storehouse with stone, but opinion was divided.

sentences.zh: 及昨臨勘，則柴塘沙性澀汕，石工斷難措手，惟有力繕柴塘，得補偏救弊之一策。

translations.literal: When I inspected yesterday, the fascine dike's sand nature was viscous and oozy; stone work absolutely could not be undertaken—only vigorously repairing the fascine dike offered the one measure of mending what is leaning and remedying harm.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection yesterday I found the sand there too loose and treacherous for stone—only a thorough repair of the fascine dike will serve, as the best way to shore up what is failing.

sentences.zh: 其悉心經理，定歲修以固塘根，增坦水石簍以資擁護。」

translations.literal: Manage it with full care, fix annual repair to strengthen the dike root, and add sloped revetment and stone cages for support."
translations.idiomatic: See to it diligently: set yearly repairs to strengthen the footings, and add sloped revetment and stone cages for protection."

sentences.zh: 又諭曰：「尖山、塔山之間，舊有石塘。

translations.literal: He further instructed: "Between Jianshan and Tashan there was formerly stone dike.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Between Jianshan and Tashan there once stood a stone dike.

sentences.zh: 朕今見其橫截海中，直逼大溜，實海塘扼要關鍵。

translations.literal: I now see it lying athwart the sea, directly confronting the main current—it is truly the critical choke point of the sea dike.
translations.idiomatic: I see it now spanning the sea and meeting the main current head-on—the true hinge of the whole defense.

sentences.zh: 就目下形勢論，或多用竹簍加鑲，或改用木櫃排砌。

translations.literal: As to the present situation, either use more bamboo cages for reinforcement, or change to wooden cribs laid in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Given present conditions, either reinforce it with more bamboo cages or rebuild it with rows of wooden cribs.

sentences.zh: 如將來沙漲漸遠，宜即改築條石壩工，俾屹然如砥柱，庶北岸海塘永資保障。

translations.literal: If in future the sand accretion gradually recedes, it is fitting at once to convert to strip-stone dam works, so that it stands firm like a pillar in midstream, and thereby the north-bank sea dikes may forever draw protection.
translations.idiomatic: If the shoal continues to build out, rebuild it as a strip-stone dam standing firm as a midstream pillar, so the north-bank dikes may be secured for good.

sentences.zh: 該督撫等其善體朕意，動帑儹辦，並勒石塔山，以志永久。」

translations.literal: Let the governors and provincial governors well embody my intent, mobilize treasury funds for preparation, and also carve stone at Tashan to record permanence."
translations.idiomatic: Let the governors carry out my wishes, draw on the treasury as needed, and inscribe a stone at Tashan to mark the work for posterity."

sentences.zh: 二十八年，蘇撫庄有恭言：「江南松、太海壖土性善坍，華亭、寶山向築坦坡，皆不足恃。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Jiangsu Governor Zhuang Yougong said: "Along the Jiangnan coast of Songjiang and Taicang the soil readily collapses; the sloped revetments formerly built at Huating and Baoshan are all insufficient to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Jiangsu Governor Zhuang Yougong wrote: "The coast of Songjiang and Taicang in Jiangnan is prone to slump; the sloped revetments at Huating and Baoshan cannot be trusted.

sentences.zh: 應仿浙江老鹽倉改建塊石簍塘。」

translations.literal: One should follow Zhejiang's Old Salt Storehouse model and convert to block-stone cage dikes."
translations.idiomatic: They should be rebuilt on the block-stone cage model used at Old Salt Storehouse in Zhejiang."

sentences.zh: 詔如所請。

translations.literal: An edict approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，帝南巡，閱視海寧海塘。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year the Emperor made a southern tour and inspected the Haining sea dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirtieth year, on his southern tour, the Emperor inspected the Haining sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「繞城石塘，實為全城保障。

translations.literal: He instructed: "The stone dike encircling the city is truly the safeguard of the whole city.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "The stone dike around the city is the city's true defense.

sentences.zh: 塘下坦水，祗建兩層，潮勢似覺頂沖。

translations.literal: Below the dike the sloped revetment has only two layers built; the tide's force seems to feel the impact at the top.
translations.idiomatic: The sloped revetment below has only two tiers, and the tide seems to strike at the crest.

sentences.zh: 若補築三層，尤資裨益。

translations.literal: If a third layer is added in repair, it will especially provide benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Adding a third tier would help greatly.

sentences.zh: 著將應建之四百六十餘丈一律添建。」

translations.literal: Order that the more than four hundred sixty zhang to be built be uniformly added and built."
translations.idiomatic: Order the full four hundred sixty-odd zhang still required to be built at once."

sentences.zh: 三月工竣。

translations.literal: In the third month the works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work was finished in the third month.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，巡撫熊學鵬請於蕭山、山陰、會稽改建魚鱗大石塘。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year Governor Xiong Xuepeng requested converting to scale-pattern great stone dikes at Xiaoshan, Shanyin, and Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year Governor Xiong Xuepeng proposed scale-pattern great stone dikes at Xiaoshan, Shanyin, and Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 帝以潮勢正趨北亹，與南岸渺不相涉，斥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the tide was tending toward Bei Wai and had nothing to do with the south bank, rebuked it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor dismissed the proposal, noting that the tide was shifting toward Bei Wai and bore no relation to the south bank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，巡撫富勒渾疏報中亹引河情形，略言：「潮頭大溜，一由蜀山直趨引河，一由岩峰山西斜入引河，至河庄山中段會合，互相撞擊，仍分兩路西行，隨令員弁於引河中段挑堰溝二十餘道，導引潮溜，俾復中亹故道。」

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year Governor Fulehun memorialized on the situation of the Zhong Wai diversion, stating in brief: "The tide head and main current—one runs straight from Shushan toward the diversion, one enters the diversion obliquely from the west of Yanfeng Mountain; at the middle section of Hezhuang Mountain they join, strike each other, and still divide into two paths running west. Officers were then ordered to open more than twenty weir channels in the middle of the diversion to guide the tidal current, so that it might return to the old channel of Zhong Wai."
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year Governor Fulehun reported on the Zhong Wai diversion: "The tide and main current—one branch runs straight from Shushan into the channel, another enters obliquely west of Yanfeng Mountain; they meet at mid-channel by Hezhuang Mountain, collide, and split again westward. I have had officers cut more than twenty channels through the middle of the diversion to steer the tide back into the old Zhong Wai course."

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「潮汛遷移，乃噓吸自然之勢，若開挖引河，恐徒勞無益。

translations.literal: He instructed: "The shifting of tidal floods is the natural pattern of exhaling and inhaling; if one digs diversion channels, I fear it may be labor in vain without benefit.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "Tides shift by nature, like breathing in and out; digging diversion channels may be wasted effort.

sentences.zh: 止宜實力保衛堤塘，以待其自循舊軌，不必執意開溝引溜，欲以人力勝海潮也。」

translations.literal: One should only earnestly defend the dikes and embankments, waiting for the tide to return of itself to the old track; there is no need stubbornly to open channels to guide the current, wishing to overcome the sea tide with human power."
translations.idiomatic: Strengthen the dikes and wait for the tide to find its old course on its own; do not insist on cutting channels to steer it—human strength cannot master the sea."

sentences.zh: 四十三年，浙撫王亶望疏陳海塘情形，命江督高晉會同相度。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year Zhejiang Governor Wang Tanwang memorialized on the sea dike situation; Jiangsu Governor-General Gao Jin was ordered to join in surveying.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year Zhejiang Governor Wang Tanwang reported on the state of the sea dikes, and Jiangsu Governor-General Gao Jin was ordered to survey them jointly.

sentences.zh: 尋疏言：「章家菴一帶柴工五百丈，潮神廟前柴塘三百丈，應添建竹簍，並排列兩層椿木以防動搖。」

translations.literal: Soon the memorial stated: "Along Zhangjia'an, five hundred zhang of fascine work; before the Tide God's Temple, three hundred zhang of fascine dike—bamboo cages should be added and built, and two layers of piled timbers arranged to guard against shifting."
translations.idiomatic: They soon proposed: "Along five hundred zhang of fascine work at Zhangjia'an and three hundred zhang before the Tide God's Temple, bamboo cages should be added, with a double row of piles to prevent movement."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，帝南巡，幸海寧尖山閱海塘。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year the Emperor made a southern tour, visited Jianshan at Haining, and inspected the sea dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, on his southern tour, the Emperor visited Jianshan at Haining to inspect the sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命大學士阿桂、南河督陳輝祖赴浙履勘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Grand Secretary Agui and Southern Rivers Director-General Chen Huizu were ordered to go to Zhejiang for on-site inspection.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Grand Secretary Agui and Southern Rivers Director-General Chen Huizu were sent to Zhejiang to inspect the works on site.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「海塘工程，應建石塘二千二百丈，若改為條石，施工易而成事速，約計三年可以蕆工。」

translations.literal: The memorial stated: "For the sea dike works, stone dike of two thousand two hundred zhang should be built; if converted to strip stone, construction is easy and completion swift—roughly three years can finish the work."
translations.idiomatic: They reported: "The sea-dike project calls for two thousand two hundred zhang of stone work; strip stone would be easier to build and finish sooner—about three years to completion."

sentences.zh: 又言：「辦理魚鱗石塘，仿東塘之例，量地勢高下，用十六層至十八層，約需三十萬。」

translations.literal: They also stated: "For scale-pattern stone dikes, following the eastern dike precedent, measuring the terrain's height and low, use sixteen to eighteen layers—roughly three hundred thousand needed."
translations.idiomatic: They added: "For scale-pattern stone dikes, built like the eastern dike with sixteen to eighteen courses according to the terrain, about three hundred thousand taels would be needed."

sentences.zh: 帝命工部侍郎楊魁駐工協辦，次年八月竣工。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Vice Minister of Works Yang Kui to remain at the works to assist; the next year in the eighth month the works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Vice Minister of Works Yang Kui to remain on site to assist; the work was finished the following eighth month.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，帝幸杭州，閱視海塘，諭曰：「老鹽倉舊有柴塘，一律添建石塘四千二百餘丈，於上年告竣，自應砌築坦水保護。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year the Emperor visited Hangzhou and inspected the sea dikes, instructing: "At Old Salt Storehouse there was formerly fascine dike; uniformly more than four thousand two hundred zhang of stone dike was added and built, completed last year—sloped revetment should naturally be laid to protect it.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year the Emperor visited Hangzhou and inspected the dikes, saying: "At Old Salt Storehouse the old fascine dike was replaced last year with more than four thousand two hundred zhang of stone; sloped revetment should have been built to protect it.

sentences.zh: 乃該督撫並未慮及，設遇異漲，豈能抵禦？

translations.literal: Yet the governors and provincial governors did not consider this; if an unusual flood tide should come, how could it be resisted?
translations.idiomatic: Yet the governors gave it no thought; if an exceptional tide should rise, how could the dike hold?

sentences.zh: 著將柴塘後之土順坡斜做，並於其上種柳，俾根株盤結，則石柴連為一勢，即以柴塘為石塘之坦水。

translations.literal: Order that the earth behind the fascine dike be shaped in sloping grade, and willows planted on it so the roots intertwine; then stone and fascine will join as one force, and the fascine dike may serve as the sloped revetment of the stone dike.
translations.idiomatic: Order the ground behind the fascine dike shaped into a slope and planted with willows so the roots bind the soil; stone and fascine will then work as one, and the fascine dike will serve as revetment for the stone.

sentences.zh: 至范公塘一帶，亦必接建石工，方於省城足資鞏護。

translations.literal: Along the Fan Gong Pond stretch as well, stone works must be joined in construction before the provincial capital can be adequately secured.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Fan Gong Pond stretch as well, stone works must be linked in before the provincial capital can be adequately protected.

sentences.zh: 著撥帑五百萬，交該督撫覈算，分限分年修築。」

translations.literal: Five million taels from the treasury are to be allocated, entrusted to the governors-general and governors for verification and calculation, and repairs carried out by stages and years."
translations.idiomatic: Five million taels from the treasury were allocated to the governors-general and governors for verification, with repairs to proceed by stages over successive years."

sentences.zh: 五十二年工竣。

translations.literal: The works were completed in the fifty-second year.
translations.idiomatic: The works were completed in Qianlong 52.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，浙撫玉德請改山陰土塘為柴塘。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, Zhejiang Governor Yude requested changing the earthen dikes at Shanyin to brush dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 Zhejiang Governor Yude requested converting the earthen dikes at Shanyin to brush dikes.

sentences.zh: 十三年，浙撫阮元請改蕭山土岸為柴塘。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Zhejiang Governor Ruan Yuan requested changing the earthen banks at Xiaoshan to brush dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 13 Zhejiang Governor Ruan Yuan requested converting the earthen banks at Xiaoshan to brush dikes.

sentences.zh: 十六年，浙撫蔣攸銛請將山陰各土塘堤一律建築柴塘；

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Zhejiang Governor Jiang Youqian requested that all earthen dikes at Shanyin be uniformly built as brush dikes;
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 16 Zhejiang Governor Jiang Youqian requested that all earthen dikes at Shanyin be rebuilt uniformly as brush dikes;

sentences.zh: 蘇撫章煦請將華亭土塘加築單壩二層。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Zhang Xu requested adding two layers of single dams to the earthen dikes at Huating.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu Governor Zhang Xu requested adding two layers of single dams atop the earthen dikes at Huating.

sentences.zh: 均從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 道光十三年五月，巡撫富呢揚阿疏言「東西兩防塘工，先擇尤險者修築，需銀五十一萬二千餘兩」。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirteenth year of Daoguang, Governor Funiyang'a memorialized: "For the eastern and western protective sea-dike works, repair the most dangerous sections first, requiring more than 512,000 taels of silver."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Daoguang 13 Governor Funiyang'a memorialized: "For the eastern and western protective sea-dike works, the most dangerous sections should be repaired first, at a cost of more than 512,000 taels."

sentences.zh: 十一月，又言「限內限外各工俱掣坍，需銀十九萬四千餘兩」。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he again reported: "Works both within and beyond the scheduled limits have all collapsed, requiring more than 194,000 taels."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he reported again: "Works both within and beyond the scheduled limits have collapsed, requiring more than 194,000 taels."

sentences.zh: 十二月，又言「東塘界內，應於前後兩塘中間，另建鱗塘二千六百餘丈，需銀九十二萬二千兩」。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he again reported: "Within the eastern dike boundary, between the front and rear dikes, a separate scale-pattern dike of more than 2,600 zhang should be built, requiring 922,000 taels."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he reported again: "Within the eastern dike boundary, a scale-pattern dike of more than 2,600 zhang should be built between the front and rear dikes, at a cost of 922,000 taels."

sentences.zh: 均下部議行。

translations.literal: All were sent to the ministry for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministry for approval and implementation.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命刑部侍郎趙盛奎、前東河督嚴烺，會同富呢揚阿查勘應修各工。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Vice Minister of Justice Zhao Shengkui and former Eastern Rivers Director Yan Huang were ordered to join Funiyang'a in surveying all works requiring repair.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 14 Vice Minister of Justice Zhao Shengkui and former Eastern Rivers Director Yan Huang were ordered to join Funiyang'a in surveying all works requiring repair.

sentences.zh: 尋疏言：「外護塘根，無如坦水，擬自念里亭汛至鎮海汛，添建盤頭三座，改建柴塘三千三百餘丈；

translations.literal: Soon they memorialized: "To protect the dike foot from without, nothing surpasses level waterworks; from Nianliting flood section to Zhenhai flood section, three disk heads are proposed to be added and more than 3,300 zhang of brush dike rebuilt;
translations.idiomatic: They soon memorialized: "To protect the dike foot from seaward attack, nothing surpasses level waterworks. From the Nianliting to the Zhenhai flood sections, we propose adding three disk heads and rebuilding more than 3,300 zhang of brush dike;

sentences.zh: 其西塘烏龍廟以東，應接築魚鱗石塊；

translations.literal: east of Wulong Temple on the western dike, scale-pattern stone blocks should be joined in construction;
translations.idiomatic: east of Wulong Temple on the western dike, scale-pattern stone blocks should be linked in;

sentences.zh: 海寧繞城石塘，應加高條石兩層。

translations.literal: the encircling stone dike at Haining should have two layers of strip stone added in height.
translations.idiomatic: the encircling stone dike at Haining should be raised by two layers of strip stone.

sentences.zh: 俟明年大汛時續辦。」

translations.literal: Work is to continue during next year's great flood season."
translations.idiomatic: Further work is to continue during the next great flood season."

sentences.zh: 遣左都御史吳椿往勘，留浙會辦。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Wu Chun was sent to survey and remained in Zhejiang to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Left Censor-in-Chief Wu Chun was sent to survey and remained in Zhejiang to supervise the work.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月工竣，計修築各工萬七千餘丈，用銀一百五十七萬有奇。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixteenth year the works were completed; in all more than seventeen thousand zhang of various works were repaired, using more than 1.57 million taels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Daoguang 16 the works were completed: more than seventeen thousand zhang of repairs in all, at a cost of more than 1.57 million taels.

sentences.zh: 三十年，巡撫吳文鎔疊陳海塘石工沖缺，令速搶辦。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Governor Wu Wenrong repeatedly reported breaches in the sea-dike stone works and ordered emergency repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 30 Governor Wu Wenrong repeatedly reported breaches in the sea-dike stonework and ordered emergency repairs.

sentences.zh: 十月工竣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work was completed in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 咸豐七年八月，海塘埽各工猝被風潮沖坍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Xianfeng, fascine works along the sea dikes were suddenly washed away by wind and tide.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xianfeng 7 fascine works along the sea dikes were suddenly destroyed by wind and tide.

sentences.zh: 十二月，次第堵合。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they were blocked up in succession.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth month they had been closed up in succession.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，御史洪燕昌言浙江海塘潰決，請速籌款修理。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, Censor Hong Yanchang reported that Zhejiang sea dikes had burst and requested funds be quickly raised for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 Censor Hong Yanchang reported that Zhejiang sea dikes had burst and asked that funds be raised quickly for repairs.

sentences.zh: 部議將浙海關等稅撥用。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated to allocate revenues from the Zhejiang maritime customs and other taxes.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved allocating revenues from the Zhejiang maritime customs and other taxes.

sentences.zh: 五年，內閣侍讀學士鍾佩賢疏陳海塘關係東南大局，有四害三可慮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Hanlin Bachelor Zhong Peixian memorialized that sea dikes concerned the great situation of the southeast, with four harms and three anxieties.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 Hanlin Bachelor Zhong Peixian memorialized that sea dikes concerned the security of the entire southeast, citing four harms and three grave concerns.

sentences.zh: 命巡撫馬新貽詳勘，修海寧魚鱗石工二百六十餘丈。

translations.literal: Governor Ma Xinyi was ordered to survey in detail and repair more than 260 zhang of scale-pattern stone works at Haining.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ma Xinyi was ordered to survey in detail and repair more than 260 zhang of scale-pattern stonework at Haining.

sentences.zh: 六年，以浙江海塘工鉅費多，議分最要次要修築，期以十年告竣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because Zhejiang sea-dike works were vast and costly, it was proposed to divide repairs into most essential and secondary, with completion expected in ten years.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6, because Zhejiang sea-dike works were vast and costly, repairs were divided into essential and secondary priorities, with completion expected within ten years.

sentences.zh: 七年，兩江總督曾國籓等請修華亭石塘護壩，嗣是塘工歲有修築。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Liangjiang Governor-General Zeng Guofan and others requested repairs to the protective dams of the stone dikes at Huating; thereafter dike works were repaired every year.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7 Liangjiang Governor-General Zeng Guofan and others requested repairs to the protective dams of the Huating stone dikes; thereafter dike works were maintained annually.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，修寶山北石塘護土，建護塘攔水各壩，及仁和、海寧魚鱗石塘千三百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu the northern stone dike at Baoshan was repaired with protective earth, protective and water-blocking dams were built, and more than 1,300 zhang of scale-pattern stone dikes at Renhe and Haining.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 the northern stone dike at Baoshan was repaired with protective earthwork, protective and water-blocking dams were built, and more than 1,300 zhang of scale-pattern stone dikes at Renhe and Haining were restored.

sentences.zh: 十年，修昭文、華亭、寶山等處塘壩及石坦坡。

translations.literal: In the tenth year dikes, dams, and stone slopes at Zhaowen, Huating, Baoshan, and elsewhere were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10 dikes, dams, and stone slopes at Zhaowen, Huating, Baoshan, and elsewhere were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十二年，浙江巡撫劉秉璋言，海鹽原建石塘四千六百餘丈，積年坍損過半，擬擇要興辦，埋砌者五百丈，建復者四百六十丈，需銀二十萬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Zhejiang Governor Liu Bingzhang reported that the originally built stone dike at Haiyan of more than 4,600 zhang had over the years collapsed in more than half; essential sections were chosen for work—500 zhang to be buried and laid in stone, 460 zhang to be rebuilt, requiring 200,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 Zhejiang Governor Liu Bingzhang reported that the original stone dike at Haiyan, more than 4,600 zhang long, had lost more than half to collapse over the years. Essential sections were chosen for repair—500 zhang to be buried and faced in stone, 460 zhang to be rebuilt—at a cost of 200,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，浙撫劉樹棠疏言，海寧繞城石塘坍塌日甚，請添築坦水，以塘工加抽絲捐積存餘款先行開辦，隨籌款次第興修。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Zhejiang Governor Liu Shutang memorialized that the encircling stone dike at Haining was collapsing daily; he requested adding level waterworks, using surplus funds from the accumulated sea-dike silk surtax to begin at once, with funds to be raised in succession for further work.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 18 Zhejiang Governor Liu Shutang memorialized that the encircling stone dike at Haining was collapsing daily. He requested adding level waterworks, using surplus funds from the accumulated sea-dike silk surtax to begin at once, with further funds to be raised in succession.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十九年，修太倉茜涇口椿石坦坡百五十一丈，鎮洋楊林口椿石二百丈，昭文施家橋至老人濱雙椿夾石護壩二百丈，華亭外塘純石斜壩四十六丈。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year 151 zhang of pile-and-stone level slope at Qianjing Mouth in Taicang, 200 zhang of pile-and-stone work at Yanglin Mouth in Zhenyang, 200 zhang of double-pile stone-protected dam from Shijia Bridge to Laorenbin in Zhaowen, and 46 zhang of pure stone sloping dam on the outer dike at Huating were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 19 repairs included 151 zhang of pile-and-stone level slope at Qianjing Mouth in Taicang, 200 zhang at Yanglin Mouth in Zhenyang, 200 zhang of double-pile stone-protected dam from Shijia Bridge to Laorenbin in Zhaowen, and 46 zhang of pure stone sloping dam on the outer dike at Huating.

sentences.zh: 綜計兩省塘工，自道光中葉大修後，疊經兵燹，半就頹圮，迄同治初，興辦大工，庫款支絀，遂開辦海塘捐輸，並勸令兩省絲商，於正捐外，加抽塘工絲捐，給票請獎。

translations.literal: In sum, sea-dike works in the two provinces, after the major repairs of mid-Daoguang, suffered repeated warfare until half lay in ruin; by early Tongzhi large works were undertaken, but treasury funds fell short, so sea-dike contributions were opened, and silk merchants in both provinces were urged to pay an additional sea-dike silk surtax beyond the regular levy, receiving tickets for awards.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, sea-dike works in the two provinces, after the major Daoguang repairs, suffered repeated warfare until half lay in ruins. By early Tongzhi large works were launched, but treasury funds fell short, so sea-dike contributions were opened and silk merchants in both provinces were urged to pay an additional sea-dike silk surtax beyond the regular levy in exchange for award tickets.

sentences.zh: 旋即停止。

translations.literal: Soon it was halted.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon halted.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年，浙江巡撫聶緝槼請復捐輸舊章，以濟要工。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu, Zhejiang Governor Nie Jigui requested restoring the old contribution regulations to fund essential works.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 Zhejiang Governor Nie Jigui requested restoring the old contribution regulations to fund essential works.

sentences.zh: 因二十七年以後，潮汐猛烈，次險者變為極險，擬將柴埽各工清底拆築，非籌集鉅款，不能歷久鞏固雲。

translations.literal: Because after the twenty-seventh year tides grew violent and sections once moderately dangerous became extremely dangerous, it is proposed to clear and rebuild all fascine works from the foundation; without raising vast funds, they cannot be secured for long.
translations.idiomatic: Because after Guangxu 27 tides grew violent and sections once moderately dangerous became extremely dangerous, it was proposed to clear and rebuild all fascine works from the foundation; without raising vast funds, they could not be secured for long.
